title: The source point is the Casson--Rivin maximum for the actual filling
text: # The source point is the Casson--Rivin maximum for the actual filling **Current scope and direct geometric input.** The [whole-color improvement](actual_pretzel_all_width_extension.md) lowers the odd-width threshold to s>=9. The [direct ideal-chart certificate](https://github.com/sashakolpakov/murakamis_dream/blob/19d5b911bc409486f0e72b51a876a6a2bc70ee02/notes/actual_pretzel_positive_ideal_angle_certificate.md) constructs a compatible positive ideal subdivision of the ACTUAL half-twisted cells and verifies the full edge/peripheral rank. Thus the variational proof for this class no longer requires a general ideal triangulation existence theorem. The [general source certificate](source_volume_casson_rivin_certificate.md) and [independent tangent audit](https://github.com/sashakolpakov/murakamis_dream/blob/19d5b911bc409486f0e72b51a876a6a2bc70ee02/notes/source_angle_stationarity_critical_audit.md) isolate precisely why stationarity holds on the entire angle slice. 29 October 2026. This records the variational equality argument requested by the user. The relevant volume is Vsrc_s(p), not the larger complete augmented volume V_s. The angle constraints must be those of the actual filled slopes. A maximum for the unfilled cusp problem would not prove the desired equality. The geometric completion inputs are the [positive-core construction](https://github.com/sashakolpakov/murakamis_dream/blob/19d5b911bc409486f0e72b51a876a6a2bc70ee02/notes/actual_long_pretzel_geometric_filling_completion.md), the [primitive angle certificate](https://github.com/sashakolpakov/murakamis_dream/blob/19d5b911bc409486f0e72b51a876a6a2bc70ee02/notes/actual_long_pretzel_primitive_filling_angle.md) and the [log-link/tube lemma](https://github.com/sashakolpakov/murakamis_dream/blob/19d5b911bc409486f0e72b51a876a6a2bc70ee02/notes/long_pretzel_equality_critical_audit.md). Stationarity does not replace smooth end completion. The [completion argument](https://github.com/sashakolpakov/murakamis_dream/blob/19d5b911bc409486f0e72b51a876a6a2bc70ee02/notes/long_pretzel_volume_equality_completion_audit.md) gives the full source equality and its scope. ## 1. The essential established quantum inputs For each fixed odd s>=9 and independently sufficiently large fixed signed integers p_i, the [whole original source theorem](https://github.com/sashakolpakov/murakamis_dream/blob/19d5b911bc409486f0e72b51a876a6a2bc70ee02/notes/actual_long_pretzel_full_source_survival.md) with the subsequent [width improvement](actual_pretzel_all_width_extension.md) gives Kraw_N=N^(3/2) exp[-is*pi*(N-1)/4] kappa^(-sum p_i) D_s(p) exp[N A_s(p)] (1+O_(s,p)(1/N)), D_s(p)!=0. The original reduced Kashaev invariant has the same absolute value. Thus its limit already exists and equals Vsrc_s(p)=2pi Re A_s(p). The steps that matter for this conclusion are: 1. Exact source transformations retain the original marked derivative channels, all colors, peripheral factors and Cartan phases. 2. The inner sums are combined coherently before estimating them. The global alias/core gap controls every color outside the cusp corridor. 3. The corridor has an exact complex analytic packet, not merely a pointwise real-grid approximation. This permits the contour estimates. 4. The exact filling transform retains every endpoint current. Its zero charge vanishes and its minimal nonzero signed charges add. This establishes the nonzero coefficient for the entire source. 5. The [literal port lift](https://github.com/sashakolpakov/murakamis_dream/blob/19d5b911bc409486f0e72b51a876a6a2bc70ee02/notes/actual_pretzel_port_lift_and_geometric_anchor.md) and [marked regulator comparison](https://github.com/sashakolpakov/murakamis_dream/blob/19d5b911bc409486f0e72b51a876a6a2bc70ee02/notes/actual_pretzel_marked_regulator_and_filling_action.md) supply an actual representation rho_p of the filled knot group and the absolute identity Vsrc_s(p)=Vol(rho_p), with the complete oriented augmented holonomy as anchor. Neither Cauchy alone nor existence of a classical stationary point establishes steps2--4. They are already supplied by the linked analytic proofs. The present task is the classical equality for this selected representation. ## 2. Obtain a positive ideal angle point from the selected source Let Y_s be the original complete augmented link complement. Choose a fixed positive geometric ideal triangulation T of Y_s. The [direct subdivision certificate](https://github.com/sashakolpakov/murakamis_dream/blob/19d5b911bc409486f0e72b51a876a6a2bc70ee02/notes/actual_pretzel_positive_ideal_angle_certificate.md), sections 1--3, supplies it from the actual face-labeled polyhedra: normalized light lifts are preserved by every white and shaded face pairing, and a finite compatible affine subdivision gives nonflat ideal tetrahedra. This uses no general triangulation existence theorem. Here "positive" means every oriented tetrahedron has shape in the upper half-plane; it is stronger than a topological ideal triangulation. The direct finite-center completion proof does not depend on this all-ideal existence input, but it supplies the customary Casson--Rivin angle presentation used in this note. Transport the finitely many developed ideal vertices of T using the actual source representation rho_z and its selected peripheral flags. At z=0 this is exactly the geometric developing configuration. A peripheral flag tends continuously to its noncentral parabolic flag: in a bounded matrix frame the eigenspace kernel has rank one at the limit, so it admits a local continuous, indeed holomorphic, choice. Every vertex orbit is well defined because its peripheral stabilizer fixes the chosen flag. All cross-ratios of the finitely many tetrahedra therefore vary continuously from strictly positive shapes. Shrink the parameter neighborhood once so every shape remains positive and nondegenerate. The actual representation identities telescope to the complex edge gluing equations. The edge angular sums are continuously close to 2pi and are integral multiples of 2pi, hence are exactly 2pi. The marked peripheral products are the actual eigenvalue multipliers. The selected filling points approach z=0 uniformly as max_i |p_i|^(-1) tends to zero. One threshold therefore puts ALL independently signed sufficiently long tuples in this fixed positive shape neighborhood. No comparability between different slopes is used. Denote their positive angle points by theta_p. ## 3. The correct affine volume problem includes the filled slopes For each tetrahedron write its positive angles as alpha,beta,gamma, with alpha+beta+gamma=pi. Let V_T(theta)=sum_t [Lambda(alpha_t)+Lambda(beta_t)+Lambda(gamma_t)], Lambda'(a)=-log(2sin a). The edge constraints are the usual linear equations with sum2pi at each edge. Fix their original angle and peripheral log lifts, continued from the complete triangulation. In projective geometric coordinates the actual auxiliary logs are U_i=Log(M_i^2)=-z_i, V_i=Log(lambda_i^2), centered at completeness,=-2ell_i. Their imaginary parts are affine real-linear functions of the tetrahedral angles in this fixed marking. The old SL longitude sign is retained in the quantum/regulator comparison; it is not an extra geometric rotation here. By the primitive-angle certificate the selected all-positive unit charge has U_i+p_i V_i=-2pi i. (1) Other minimal signed charges replace the right side by -2pi i m_i, |m_i|=1, on their corresponding eigenflag marks. It suffices to use the all-positive charge, whose nonzero contribution is already proved. Define A_p to be the positive angle polytope satisfying the tetrahedral and edge equations, the REAL linear filling-angle constraints Im U_i+p_i Im V_i=-2pi, i=1,...,s, (2) and Im U_0=0 on a chosen primitive meridian of the remaining main cusp. The latter cusp is actually fully parabolic in rho_p, so U_0=V_0=0. The source point theta_p belongs to the INTERIOR of this affine slice. The full nonlinear holonomy equations are not being imposed as convex constraints. Only their imaginary, angle-linear parts define A_p. The real parts will give stationarity of volume. ## 4. The source equations imply stationarity on the entire angle slice Set x_t=Log z_t and y_t=Log z_t'', z_t''=1-z_t^(-1), with Im x_t=alpha_t and Im y_t=gamma_t. The sine rule gives Re x_t=log(sin beta_t/sin gamma_t), Re y_t=log(sin alpha_t/sin beta_t). For EVERY infinitesimal angle variation, not merely a variation through geometric solutions, direct differentiation gives dV_T(delta theta)=sum_t [Re x_t delta gamma_t -Re y_t delta alpha_t]. (3) Let E be the real space of edge Hamiltonians in the standard shape symplectic space Omega=sum dx_t wedge dy_t. Both the real logarithmic shape vector of a gluing solution and any tangent satisfying the edge angle equations lie in E^perp. The already established [boundary pairing](https://github.com/sashakolpakov/murakamis_dream/blob/19d5b911bc409486f0e72b51a876a6a2bc70ee02/notes/bloch_lift_and_boundary_torsor.md), summed over the boundary tori, reduces Omega there to Omega_red=-(1/2)sum_i dU_i wedge dV_i. Distinct tori have zero intersection pairing; on each torus the primitive peripheral rows have pairing -2. Thus at theta_p equation(3) becomes the boundary formula for arbitrary angle tangents dV_T(delta theta) =(1/2)sum_i [Re V_i delta Im U_i -Re U_i delta Im V_i]. (4) This is not obtained by restricting the derivative to the smaller variety of full complex gluing solutions. The coisotropic pairing justifies its use for every tangent of A_p. For each filled cusp, the real part of(1) says Re U_i=-p_i Re V_i. Its contribution to(4) is therefore (1/2)Re V_i [delta Im U_i+p_i delta Im V_i]=0 by(2). The main cusp contributes zero because U_0=V_0=0. Consequently dV_T(theta_p)|_(T_theta_p A_p)=0. (5) This is the full constrained critical-point condition requested in the Casson--Rivin argument. It uses the actual filled slopes and their centered integer angles, rather than the unfilled cusp maximum. ## 5. Strict concavity makes this the unique global maximum On one tetrahedron, in coordinates alpha,gamma with beta=pi-alpha-gamma, the negative Hessian is [[cot alpha+cot beta, cot beta], [cot beta, cot gamma+cot beta]]. (6) Its determinant is1. Its first diagonal entry equals sin(gamma)/(sin(alpha)sin(beta))>0. It is positive definite on the entire positive angle simplex. Summing proves strict concavity of V_T on every affine angle slice, including A_p. For any other point of the closure of A_p, the straight segment from theta_p stays positive until its possible final endpoint. Along it the first derivative starts at zero by(5), and the second derivative is strictly negative unless the point is unchanged. Continuity of Lambda at the boundary then gives V_T(theta)<V_T(theta_p), theta!=theta_p. (7) Thus the source point is the UNIQUE global maximizer of the full filled-slope angle polytope, including its boundary. No gradient-flow convergence assumption or numerical maximum is required. ## 6. Smooth completion identifies the maximum with hyperbolic volume The value of the positive developed fundamental triangulation is V_T(theta_p)=D(beta(rho_p))=Vsrc_s(p). (8) Here the absolute marked regulator comparison fixes the constant; one is not defining an unknown source action to be volume. For completeness, the geometric content behind the generalized Casson--Rivin conclusion is proved directly by the companion notes. The positive finite-center deformation supplies a local hyperbolic metric on the same compact core. Its auxiliary cusp links are positive Euclidean similarity tori. After placing their chosen flags at infinity, the second common affine fixed point q escapes to infinity near the complete structure. The finite link development avoids q. Therefore Log(dev-q) gives a nonsingular translation structure on a COMPACT torus. Its flat metric is complete, so its universal developing map is the whole complex plane, with its actual rank-two period lattice. The end contains a full punctured hyperbolic tube. The [primitive-angle certificate](https://github.com/sashakolpakov/murakamis_dream/blob/19d5b911bc409486f0e72b51a876a6a2bc70ee02/notes/actual_long_pretzel_primitive_filling_angle.md) proves that its actual meridian period is exactly -2pi i, not that integer merely modulo2pi. Hence the tube completes to a smooth solid torus with the specified primitive slope. The main cusp stays complete. The [tube lemma](https://github.com/sashakolpakov/murakamis_dream/blob/19d5b911bc409486f0e72b51a876a6a2bc70ee02/notes/long_pretzel_equality_critical_audit.md) proves both the degree-one statement and the finite-volume completion. The resulting complete oriented metric g_p is on the ACTUAL filled knot complement. Its holonomy is rho_p. This supplies the geometric equality certificate that strict concavity or scalar PSL holonomy alone would not provide. The user's Gromov-norm observation gives a short final comparison. Apply the independently proved [sharp representation-volume inequality](https://github.com/sashakolpakov/murakamis_dream/blob/19d5b911bc409486f0e72b51a876a6a2bc70ee02/notes/regular_critical_values_and_representation_volume_bound.md) with the specified hyperbolic metric g_hyp as domain and g_p holonomy as target. Then reverse their roles using the same oriented topological marking. Fundamental chains have degree one in both directions, so Vol(g_p)<=Vol(g_hyp), Vol(g_hyp)<=Vol(g_p). No separate unproved equality case of the norm inequality is invoked. These two inequalities prove Vsrc_s(p)=max_(theta in A_p) V_T(theta) =Vol(g_p)=Vol(S^3 minus K). (9) ## 7. Quantum conclusion and quantifiers Combining(9) with the whole-source asymptotic and the independently audited positive-core, primitive-period and tube certificates proves the requested original-invariant equality: lim_(N->infinity) (2pi/N)log|<K>_N|=Vol(S^3 minus K). With the later whole-color improvement, the class is each fixed odd width s>=9, all independently sufficiently large fixed signed p_i, the original boxes R^(-(2p_i+1)), and the standing hyperbolicity assumption. The common threshold may increase to place the selected source points inside the fixed geometric neighborhood. There is no upper bound on width across the class, no comparability or common-sign condition on the slopes, and no restriction to prime levels or one parity. This note does not assert the quantum limit for all hyperbolic knots or for slopes growing with N. ## 8. Literature coverage, not a proof premise The [Futer--Gueritaud survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/1004.0440) describes Casson--Rivin's critical-volume characterization of hyperbolic structures. That classical variational framework is established territory; this note does not claim to invent it. The contribution needed for this project is verifying its hypotheses for the point selected by the ENTIRE original quantum source, with the actual filled slopes and marked logarithms. Equations(3)--(7) and the companion geometric completion arguments are proved here rather than imported from the survey. The geometric ideal-triangulation input used for this angle presentation is the previously audited argument of [Ge, version1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.27635v1); the independent finite-center completion route avoids making that input necessary for the final volume equality itself.

title: Why a moving multiplication trace cannot be bounded at the same indices
status: An exponential counterexample to a trace bound at unchanged indices
text: # Why a moving multiplication trace cannot be bounded at the same indices 1 November 2026. A product junction in a Conway calculation multiplies several tangle operators before taking their trace. After expanding those operators in the complete Newton basis, one obtains traces of products of basis polynomials. A tempting estimate would bound each moving trace by a polynomial in the level times its complete trace at exactly the same basis indices. This estimate is false, even for a junction with nine incident factors and a strictly positive complete trace. Here “high” refers to a Newton basis index greater than \(\lfloor(N-1)/2\rfloor\). It does not refer to the physical color of an auxiliary crossing circle. The example has exactly one high index and satisfies the complete pairwise support inequalities. Its moving-to-complete ratio grows exponentially along both level parities. The proof below keeps the exact quotient trace, including derivatives at repeated roots. The conclusion concerns an individual tensor entry, not a knot invariant or a whole tangle contraction. The [reflected Fourier estimate](../papers/moving-meridian-sources/README.md) and the [general component comparison](../papers/moving-meridian-sources/README.md) explain how the full source can still be controlled: they compare the change in the trace with a different, reflected index and retain the neighboring branch profiles. ## 1. Conventions and the family Let \(\mathcal T_N\) be the monic normalized Chebyshev polynomial characterized by \(\mathcal T_N(u+u^{-1})=u^N+u^{-N}\). The level is \(N\), the complete meridian is \(s=0\), and the moving meridian is \(M=q^s\). Set \(S_0=B_0=1\). Use the fixed complete Newton polynomials \[ \begin{gathered} N\ge2,\quad d=N-1,\quad q=e^{\pi i/N},\quad c_j=2\cos((2j+1)\pi/N),\\ S_n=\prod_{r=1}^n2\sin(\pi r/N),\qquad B_n(z)=\prod_{j=0}^{n-1}(c_j-z),\qquad e_n=B_n/S_n^2,\\ P_0(z)=\mathcal T_N(z)+2,\qquad P_s=P_0+\Delta_s,\qquad \Delta_s=2\cos(2\pi s)-2,\\ \phi_s(F)=(-1)^dN^2[z^d]\operatorname{rem}_{P_s}F. \end{gathered} \tag{1} \] The node index runs over \(0\le j\le d\), and the basis consists of \(e_0,\ldots,e_d\). Here \(\operatorname{rem}_{P_s}F\) is the unique remainder of degree less than \(N\) after division by the monic polynomial \(P_s\), and \([z^d]\) extracts its coefficient of \(z^d\). All products in the trace are ordinary polynomial products followed by this single exact quotient reduction. Thus repeated-root derivative data are retained, rather than replacing the trace by evaluations only. For an integer \(a\ge7\), take \[ N=5a+1,\qquad d=5a,\qquad h=4a, \qquad \mathcal Z_a(s)=\phi_s(e_h e_a^8). \tag{2} \] There are nine factors. Exactly one index, \(h\), is high. The other eight indices equal \(a=d-h\). Each high/low pair has sum \(d\), each low/low pair has sum \(2a<d\), and the total is \(12a>d\). These are the complete pairwise and total-sum support conditions; a tuple satisfying them is called complete-admissible here. Its support is on a pair-equality face; no assertion of strict interior admissibility is being made. We prove an exact identity \[ \mathcal Z_a(s)=\mathcal Z_a(0)+(-1)^a\Delta_s\mathcal B_a, \qquad \mathcal Z_a(0)>0,\quad \mathcal B_a>0, \tag{3} \] and the explicit lower bound \[ \boxed{\displaystyle \frac{\mathcal B_a}{\mathcal Z_a(0)} \ge\frac1{3(5a+1)} \left(\frac{25000}{6561}\right)^a.} \tag{4} \] For every fixed \(s\) with \(\Delta_s\ne0\), (3)–(4) imply \[ \frac{|\mathcal Z_a(s)|}{\mathcal Z_a(0)} \ge \frac{|\Delta_s|}{3(5a+1)} \left(\frac{25000}{6561}\right)^a-1. \tag{5} \] In particular no power of \(N\), even with a constant depending on a fixed disk \(|s|\le R<1\), can bound this ratio for any \(R>0\). One may choose one fixed nonzero real or imaginary \(s\) in that disk. As \(a\) varies, the levels in (2) include both parities. For even \(a\) and imaginary nonzero \(s\), both summands in (3) are positive; (5) does not require this favorable sign. ## 2. An exact complementary-index identity The reflection of the complete nodes gives \(B_N=(-1)^NP_0\) and \(B_hB_{a+1}=B_N\), since \(h+a=d\). Also \(S_hS_a=N\). Consequently \[ e_he_a=\frac{(-1)^d}{N^2}\frac{P_0(z)}{z-c_a}. \tag{6} \] The denominator on the right divides \(P_0\); the expression is a polynomial. Put \(F=e_a^7\) and \[ D(z)=\frac{F(z)-F(c_a)}{z-c_a}. \tag{7} \] Then \(\deg D=7a-1<2N-1\). A single division by \(P_0\) has quotient degree at most \(N-2\). Replacing \(P_0\) by \(P_0+\Delta_s\) therefore does not change the top trace coefficient: \[ \phi_s(D)=\phi_0(D). \tag{8} \] The same degree argument gives \(\phi_s(e_he_a)=1\). Multiplying (6) by \(F\), using (7), and reducing \(P_0=-\Delta_s\) proves \[ \mathcal Z_a(s) =F(c_a)-\Delta_s\frac{(-1)^d}{N^2}\phi_0(D). \tag{9} \] There is no quadratic or higher term in \(\Delta_s\). The exact complete value is \[ \mathcal Z_a(0)=F(c_a) =\left(\frac{S_{2a}}{S_a^2}\right)^7>0. \tag{10} \] Here \(B_a(c_a)=S_{2a}\), obtained by multiplying \(c_r-c_a=4\sin((a+r+1)\pi/N)\sin((a-r)\pi/N)\) for \(0\le r<a\). ## 3. Removing the repeated upper nodes A divided difference records polynomial interpolation at several points; when points repeat, it records derivatives there as well. For a real node multiset \(\Lambda=(\lambda_0,\ldots,\lambda_m)\), including repetitions, write \(F[\Lambda]\) for the Hermite divided difference. It has the algebraic description \[ F[\Lambda]=[z^{-1}] \frac{F(z)}{\prod_{j=0}^m(z-\lambda_j)}, \tag{11} \] where the coefficient is in the Laurent expansion at infinity. This is the top coefficient of the polynomial remainder, so (11) requires no limiting choice of distinct roots. Let \(\Lambda_N=(c_0,\ldots,c_d)\), the roots of \(P_0\) with their actual multiplicities. Equations (7) and (11) give \[ \frac{(-1)^d}{N^2}\phi_0(D) =D[\Lambda_N]=F[c_a,\Lambda_N]. \tag{12} \] The last equality follows by writing \(F=(z-c_a)D+F(c_a)\); the constant term divided by a monic polynomial of degree \(N+1\) has no \(z^{-1}\) coefficient. The nodes \(c_0,\ldots,c_{a-1}\) are all larger than \(c_a\), and each occurs twice in \(\Lambda_N\). Cancel their quadratic factor \(B_a(z)^2\) between numerator and denominator in (11). Since \(F=B_a^7/S_a^{14}\), this gives \[ F[c_a,\Lambda_N] =G[\Lambda_a],\qquad G(z)=\frac{B_a(z)^5}{S_a^{14}}. \tag{13} \] The remaining multiset \(\Lambda_a\) consists of the \(N-2a=3a+1\) uncanceled complete nodes, together with the one extra \(c_a\). It therefore has \(3a+2\) nodes, every one at most \(c_a\), and the divided-difference order is \[ m=3a+1. \tag{14} \] This cancellation includes repeated-node derivatives exactly. Put \(\delta_r=c_r-c_a>0\) for \(0\le r<a\). On the entire interval below \(c_a\), \[ G(c_a-v)=\frac1{S_a^{14}} \prod_{r=0}^{a-1}(\delta_r+v)^5, \qquad v\ge0. \tag{15} \] Every coefficient in this polynomial in \(v\) is positive. Hence \((-1)^mG^{(m)}(z)>0\) for \(z\le c_a\), and its magnitude is at least its magnitude at \(c_a\). The real divided-difference formula is \[ G[\lambda_0,\ldots,\lambda_m] =\int_{\substack{t_j\ge0\\\sum t_j=1}} G^{(m)}\!\left(\sum t_j\lambda_j\right)\,dt, \tag{16} \] with simplex measure of total mass \(1/m!\). It follows by repeated use of the fundamental theorem of calculus and remains valid for repeated nodes by continuity. Since all the nodes in (13) are at most \(c_a\), (15)–(16) prove \[ \operatorname{sign}G[\Lambda_a]=(-1)^m, \qquad |G[\Lambda_a]| \ge\frac{|G^{(m)}(c_a)|}{m!}. \tag{17} \] Equations (9), (12) and (14) now give (3), with \(\mathcal B_a=|G[\Lambda_a]|\): the coefficient of \(\Delta_s\) has sign \(-(-1)^{3a+1}=(-1)^a\). ## 4. An explicit exponential lower bound Let \(L_a=c_0-c_a\), so \(0<\delta_r\le L_a\). The coefficient of \(v^m\) in (15), divided by \(F(c_a)\), is \[ \frac1{B_a(c_a)^2} e_m(\delta_0^{-1},\ldots,\delta_0^{-1}, \ldots,\delta_{a-1}^{-1},\ldots,\delta_{a-1}^{-1}), \tag{18} \] where each reciprocal appears five times and \(e_m\) in this formula denotes the elementary symmetric polynomial, rather than a Newton basis element. Each of its \(\binom{5a}{m}\) summands is at least \(L_a^{-m}\), while \(B_a(c_a)^2\le L_a^{2a}\). Therefore \[ \frac{\mathcal B_a}{F(c_a)} \ge \binom{5a}{3a+1}\,L_a^{-(5a+1)}. \tag{19} \] For \(a\ge7\), \[ \frac{2a+1}{5a+1}\le\frac5{12},\qquad c_a\ge2\cos\frac{5\pi}{12}>\frac12, \qquad L_a<\frac32. \tag{20} \] The middle term of a binomial distribution with \(5a\) trials and success probability \(3/5\) is a mode. Its mass is at least \(1/(5a+1)\). Thus \[ \binom{5a}{3a}\ge\frac1{5a+1} \left(\frac{5^5}{3^3 2^2}\right)^a, \qquad \binom{5a}{3a+1}=\binom{5a}{3a}\frac{2a}{3a+1} \ge\frac12\binom{5a}{3a}. \tag{21} \] Insert (20)–(21) into (19). The remaining factor is \[ \frac{1}{2(5a+1)} \left(\frac{5^5}{3^3 2^2}\right)^a \left(\frac23\right)^{5a+1} =\frac1{3(5a+1)}\left(\frac{25000}{6561}\right)^a, \tag{22} \] which proves (4). In particular, for any fixed \(\Delta_s\ne0\), \[ \liminf_{a\to\infty}\frac1{5a+1} \log\frac{|\mathcal Z_a(s)|}{\mathcal Z_a(0)} \ge\frac15\log\frac{25000}{6561}>0. \tag{23} \] ## 5. What the obstruction rules out The family disproves a uniform pointwise estimate \(|\phi_s(\prod e_i)|\le N^{C_R}\phi_0(\prod e_i)\) on all complete-admissible tuples of a fixed valence. Allowing a prefactor depending on \(R\) does not help. There is a strictly positive complete denominator, exactly one high input, and an explicit exponential lower bound. The same construction applies at both even and odd levels. The indices lie on complete pair-equality faces. The example does not disprove an estimate restricted to a fixed strict compact interior window. More fundamentally, a tensor entry does not include the neighboring physical coefficient profiles or the sum over shared indices. Those additional factors and correlations are part of the whole Conway source. This is therefore not a counterexample to a knot-volume theorem. The useful replacement is a bound on the difference between the moving and complete traces. In the exact Fourier formula for that difference, the first Fourier contribution cancels. The [reflected Fourier theorem](../papers/moving-meridian-sources/README.md) bounds the remaining contribution by a complete trace with the high index \(h\) replaced by the low index \(d-h\), with a strict exponential improvement on the relevant regular windows. It does not assert the false comparison at unchanged indices proved impossible here. The [general component theorem](../papers/moving-meridian-sources/README.md) combines this reflected estimate with exact Frobenius contraction and the original coupled positive action. Reflection can fuse two junctions in a comparison tree; the geometric pressure of that tree is no greater than the original pressure. These comparison operations bound correction terms without changing the actual knot, the original finite source, or its marked filling action. Thus the obstruction explains why that proof retains whole contractions instead of using an estimate on each unchanged tensor entry.

title: Actual marked-theta link, four octahedra and its source angle slice
text: # Actual marked-theta link, four octahedra and its source angle slice 29 October 2026. The marked two-vertex source is literally a three-box fully augmented pretzel diagram, with its crossing circles retained. This gives the missing source-to-topology dictionary. Its complement has volume 4v8 for ANY fixed signed twists on the three physical boxes. The independently proved whole-source limit is therefore its actual hyperbolic volume. An explicit sixteen-tetrahedron angle assignment also realizes the full untwisted scalar rate, not just its value at the maximum. This is a local three-circle result, not a general graph theorem. ## 1. Literal original source, before any channel decomposition Let C be the actual auxiliary [2,1,1,2] three-braid, closed on its third head with the original pivot. Its complete-color value is L_N by the [all-input circle theorem](https://github.com/sashakolpakov/murakamis_dream/blob/19d5b911bc409486f0e72b51a876a6a2bc70ee02/notes/actual_crossing_circle_source_and_filling.md). It is an actual additional link component, with no division by its zero ordinary quantum dimension. On six ordered physical heads place R^(e_1)L_N on heads12, R^(e_2)L_N on heads34, and R^(e_3)L_N on heads56. Use the matching (16),(23),(45) at the bottom and the top. At the bottom use the original cups; at the top use ordinary caps on23 and45, and the sole original unrestricted marked row on16. Explicitly they are p_ab=N x^(-b)delta_(a+b,d), ell_ab=x^a delta_(a+b,d)/N, m_ab=x^b/N^2. This is EXACTLY the original s=3 pretzel source A_(3,N)(R^(e_1)L_N,R^(e_2)L_N,R^(e_3)L_N) (1) in the [literal source and transfer theorem](https://github.com/sashakolpakov/murakamis_dream/blob/19d5b911bc409486f0e72b51a876a6a2bc70ee02/notes/actual_odd_pretzel_augmented_transfer_source.md). The black matching is precisely p_16 p_23 p_45, and its white caps and marked arc are precisely those used in the [all-channel marked contraction](https://github.com/sashakolpakov/murakamis_dream/blob/19d5b911bc409486f0e72b51a876a6a2bc70ee02/notes/actual_trivalent_all_channel_marked_contraction.md). Thus its raw scalar is the WHOLE channel sum Theta_N(e) in the [whole-label theorem](https://github.com/sashakolpakov/murakamis_dream/blob/19d5b911bc409486f0e72b51a876a6a2bc70ee02/notes/actual_trivalent_marked_theta_label_asymptotic.md). There is no additional trace average, magnetic projection or state replacement in (1). Keeping the original marked row first is essential: the total physical degree later forces its missing degree equation. The three cup factors N^3, two ordinary cap factors N^-2 and marked factor N^-2 leave exactly the original one-cut factor N^-1. That factor is already inside (1). The auxiliary circles remain ordinary closed components. When e_i is even, its two physical strands do not swap endpoints; when it is odd, they do. Following the displayed matchings determines all main components. At e=(0,0,0) there are three main components and three crossing circles, hence six components. Other parity choices change the main component count, not the retained three circles. ## 2. Reversible actual face cut and the hyperbolic complement The explicit projection-plane and crossing-disk cut of the [augmented pretzel geometry](https://github.com/sashakolpakov/murakamis_dream/blob/19d5b911bc409486f0e72b51a876a6a2bc70ee02/notes/actual_augmented_pretzel_geometric_volume.md) applies to (1), including its untwisted diagram. At s=3 each of the two cut projection cells P_3 has ideal vertices Z_k,U_k^+,U_k^-, k mod3, and faces W_+=(U_2^+,U_1^+,U_0^+), W_-=(U_0^-,U_1^-,U_2^-), Q_k=(Z_k,U_k^+,Z_(k+1),U_k^-), T_k^+=(Z_k,U_(k-1)^+,U_k^+), T_k^-=(Z_k,U_k^-,U_(k-1)^-). (2) Here the k-th retained crossing disk is the bowtie T_k^+,T_k^-, with common crossing-circle vertex Z_k. The planar arc between two disks is Q_k. The two other projection regions are W_+,W_-. These are the faces traced from the actual ordered pretzel matching; restoring the disk collars reverses the cut. The two projection copies p=0,1 have opposite orientations. White faces W_+,W_-,Q_k glue across p by the identity label map. For e_k even, the shaded gluing is WITHIN each projection copy, T_k^+ -> T_k^-, Z_k -> Z_k, U_(k-1)^+ -> U_(k-1)^-, U_k^+ -> U_k^-. For e_k odd it is ACROSS the projection copies, with the two outer indices exchanged: T_k^+(p) -> T_k^-(1-p), Z_k -> Z_k, U_(k-1)^+ -> U_k^-, U_k^+ -> U_(k-1)^-. (3) The cross-copy change is part of the oriented half-twist gluing. A swap within the same oriented copy would be a different map. Each P_3 is the double of the directly constructed right-angled ideal triangular antiprism across its triangular base. That antiprism is a regular ideal octahedron. Thus (2),(3) use FOUR actual regular ideal octahedra. The supporting planes and Lorentz-normal proof are given in the cited geometry construction; no polyhedron recognition is being inferred from the quantum growth constant. Every edge cycle in (2),(3) has four right angles. The regular octahedral symmetries and the displayed reflections preserve the canonical horospheres. Consequently there is no edge dilation, and the ideal links are connected nonsingular flat tori. Shrinking their horospheres gives full complete finite-volume cusp ends and a compact core. This constructs the complete hyperbolic metric on the literal complement, with Vol(S^3 minus L(e))=4v8. (4) All choices of the three parities have the same metric volume. A further full twist is the actual crossing-disk collar twist. With the crossing circle RETAINED, it changes the boundary marking by an integral disk-longitude shear. After the disk boundary is treated as a cusp, the induced pure three-punctured-sphere map is isotopic to the identity: one can undo the collar rotation allowing that cusp boundary to rotate. Thus the unmarked complementary gluing remains the one in (3). This is an unmarked-complement homeomorphism, not invariance of the quantum source or its preferred filling slope. Positive versus negative odd crossings differ by just such full twists. Hence (4) holds for all fixed signed integer triples e. ## 3. An actual positive ideal angle slice for the scalar rate Here take the UNTWiSTED gluing, e=(0,0,0). Split each P_3 across its internal triangle (Z_0,Z_1,Z_2). The four octahedra are O_(p,s), p,s in {0,1}; s records the plus/minus half. After forgetting that sign in the abstract labels, each octahedron has vertices Z_0,Z_1,Z_2,U_0,U_1,U_2 and faces Z=(Z_0,Z_1,Z_2), U=(U_0,U_1,U_2), q_k=(Z_k,U_k,Z_(k+1)), t_k=(Z_k,U_(k-1),U_k). All maps fix the abstract vertex indices. Faces Z,t_k flip s; faces U,q_k flip p. Every octahedral boundary-edge cycle therefore visits all four (p,s) cells with the same abstract edge label. There are twelve such cycles. Ideal vertex classes have the six labels Z_0,Z_1,Z_2,U_0,U_1,U_2, the actual six cusps. In EVERY octahedron choose the opposite-vertex axis A=Z_0, B=U_1, (v_0,v_1,v_2,v_3)=(Z_1,Z_2,U_2,U_0). Triangulate it by (A,B,v_i,v_(i+1)), i mod4, with the appropriate positive orientation. This is a genuine triangulation of the regular octahedron; all boundary faces are its existing triangles. The resulting triangulation of the actual link has sixteen positive ideal tetrahedra and four distinct internal axis edges. For ANY 0<x_i<1/2 assign to the i-th tetrahedron in cell (p,s) alpha_(p,s,i)=pi x_(i+2p+s mod4), beta_(p,s,i)=pi/2-alpha_(p,s,i). Put dihedral angle pi/2 on AB and its opposite v_i v_(i+1), alpha on A v_i and B v_(i+1), and beta on the two other opposite edges. Each tetrahedron is a positive ideal angle triple. Internal axis edges have four right angles. The four equatorial boundary edges also contribute one right angle per cell, hence 2pi per cycle. A radial boundary edge at v_i has, in one octahedron, angle pi/2+alpha_i-alpha_(i-1) at A, pi/2-alpha_i+alpha_(i-1) at B. For each column i the four cells use each of x_0,...,x_3 exactly once. Summing either radial expression over its actual four-cell edge cycle is EXACTLY 2pi. This proves all edge angle equations symbolically on the entire open four-cube. It is not a test only at the regular point. Each of the four right-tetrahedron angle triples (pi x_i,pi/2-pi x_i,pi/2) occurs four times. Thus the actual angle volume on this slice is V_angle(x)=4 sum_(i=1)^4 [Lambda(pi x_i)+Lambda(pi/2-pi x_i)]. (5) Let a_i be the continuum limits of j_i/N and S=sum a_i. On the supported folded source set S>=1, a_i<=1/2, put x_i=S/2-a_i, i=1,2,3, x_4=1-S/2. These lie in the closed half-angle cube and sum to one. Interior labels give its positive slice; physical boundary labels are limits. The exact finite half-steps and prefactors stay in the whole-label source proof, rather than being called continuum shape equations. Its fully magnetic-contracted factorial rate is E=sum_i[L(2x_i)-4L(x_i)] =-2 sum_i[L(x_i)+L(1/2-x_i)], L(t)=integral_0^t log(2sin pi u)du. Since L(t)=-Lambda(pi t)/pi, (5) gives the PRECISE calibration V_angle(x)=2pi E(x). (6) Hence the source rate is the volume functional of an explicit positive angle slice in the ACTUAL triangulation. Each summand in (5) is strictly concave in x_i, with its unique maximum at 1/4. At this point every tetrahedron has shape i and the entire face and cusp certificate of section2 applies. It is the actual complete metric, not a merely lower-dimensional critical point of the source. In particular its full fixed-periphery criticality follows from the complete gluing and the already proved [full-slice variational certificate](source_volume_casson_rivin_certificate.md). This distinguishes the actual geometric anchor from stationarity only along the displayed source family. Off-center angles in this slice are NOT asserted to solve the real modulus gluing equations or to be actual link representations. For example the complex shape product around one internal axis is, up to the chosen reciprocal convention, product_i tan(pi x_i). The equation sum x_i=1 does not force that product to one. This is a precise additional geometric equation, not a missing angle sum. At the maximum it is one. No peripheral meridian meaning is assigned to the INTERNAL labels x_i. ## 4. Original external line and the actual volume equality The [complete augmented-source normalization](actual_complete_augmented_source_normalization.md) applies to this multicomponent diagram. It proves scalarity on the chosen original cut without using link connectivity. At complete color the physical twist is theta_d=kappa^(-1), hence all prescribed framing/peripheral characters have modulus one. Thus for the original one-cut enhanced Kashaev evaluation |<L(e)>_N|=|Theta_N(e)|. (7) For the full one-cut modified convention the additional entire dimension specializes to i^(N+3)/N, so its absolute value is |Theta_N(e)|/N. There is one such factor, not one per component. All auxiliary circle traces and all Cartan phases were already inside (1). No division by [N]=0 is introduced in either statement. The whole-label theorem proves for every FIXED signed e and both level parities, including composites, Theta_N(e)=N^(3/2)e^(2Nj0) Omega_N^(sum e) /[16 product_i sqrt(2-i e_i)] (1+O_e(1/N)), j0=v8/pi. Each square root has positive real part, so its leading coefficient is nonzero. Combining this actual source result with (4),(7) proves lim_(N->infinity) (2pi/N)log|<L(e)>_N| =4v8=Vol(S^3 minus L(e)). (8) The modified one-cut version has the same rate. The half-twist and full-twist source phases have been retained throughout; their geometric volume invariance has not been used to delete crossings from the quantum tensor diagram. ## 5. Reusable geometry and the remaining graph gate If only the white faces of the two P_3 projection cells are glued, the remaining shaded faces form six totally geodesic pairs of ideal triangles, one pair for each T_k^+ or T_k^-. Each is a genuine three-punctured sphere: its three sides are glued by the original white identity maps, and its two corners at each ideal puncture join to a cusp. Orthogonality of white and shaded faces makes the seam across every boundary edge smooth and totally geodesic. Thus this is a concrete four-octahedron geometric block with six geodesic pants boundary components. Matching boundary pants by any orientation-compatible puncture permutation preserves their canonical equal horocycles and gives a reusable complete geometric gluing operation. The theta link is obtained by the three recorded pairings of those pants. This does NOT yet identify a quantum six-port block for arbitrary graph sewing. Formula (1) closes all three circles and the entire magnetic tensor with a particular white/marked partner. A larger graph does not in general contain that closed local contraction. Its open kernel must retain the three paired normals, ordered boundary sources and the unique physical mark. One cannot replace that kernel by the positive scalar in (1), or apply the Latin angle assignment across a different graph without its actual edge table. The four-octahedron block and (6) are explicit local geometric data; the open-source identification is the remaining substantive gate. The [focused audit](../experiments/audit_actual_marked_theta_link_and_angle_geometry.py) checks the affine sixteen-tetrahedron angle equations in exact rational coefficients, all eight actual half-twist face/cusp patterns, and eighteen original full-Cartan signed marked tensor sources against the literal s=3 pretzel transfer. No software volume recognition or numerical constant fit is used in this certificate.

title: The marked crossing-circle rectangle has ratio at most one
status: Actual primitive-word bound c at most one
text: # The marked crossing-circle rectangle has ratio at most one A crossing circle in an augmented link surrounds two main strands. Its complete cusp has a distinguished rectangle determined by the original crossing disk and its meridian paths. This note proves that the positive ratio \(c\) of that disk-framed rectangle satisfies \[ 0<c\le1. \tag{1} \] The hypothesis is an actual complete right-angled matching-polyhedron certificate, including its labeled face pairings and primitive peripheral curves. An abstract ideal rectangle without those identifications need not satisfy (1). The consequence is a restriction on the trace used by the quantum recoupling formula: it lies at or below \(-2\). The proof is geometric but short. The marked paths make the target an element of the complete manifold's holonomy group. If \(c>1\), that element would be an elliptic rotation with an interior fixed axis, contradicting the free deck action. The endpoint \(c=1\) is a nonidentity parabolic element and is allowed. ## 1. The rectangle and the based meridian matrices Assume the labeled cut, complete cusp metric and primitive crossing-circle paths of the [matching-polyhedron certificate](../papers/marked-fillings/README.md). In its disk-framed coordinate, the rectangle has vertices \[ (1,E,-1,-E),\qquad E=e^{2\pi i x},\qquad 0<x<\tfrac12,\qquad c=\cot(\pi x)>0. \] The parameter \(x\) describes this rectangle. The number \(c\) is its ratio in the stated disk framing, not an arbitrary choice of Euclidean scale. Let \(A,B\) be determinant-one lifts of the two based main-meridian holonomies. Their basepaths are those of the original threading diagram. They can be normalized as \[ A=-\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix},\qquad B=-\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\-4&1\end{pmatrix}. \] Put \(P=BA\), \(H=P+I\), so \(H^2=0\). The pure transport through the crossing disk has the form \(C=I+bH\), and the transported outgoing meridian is \(B_{\mathrm{out}}=CBC^{-1}\). The retained half-twist sign is \(\epsilon\in\{0,+1,-1\}\). Let \(\tau_\epsilon\) be the primitive cusp shape in that actual signed diagram. The collar calculation and quantum sign calibration give \[ \tau_\epsilon=\frac{2ic}{1-\epsilon ic},\qquad b-\frac\epsilon2=\frac1{\tau_\epsilon},\qquad b=-\frac{i}{2c}. \tag{2} \] Thus the same coefficient \(b\) is obtained for all three retained signs. The inverse cup bend in the quantum contraction fixes the target word. It is \[ W=B^{-1}B_{\mathrm{out}},\qquad \operatorname{Tr}W=2+16b^2=2-\frac4{c^2}. \tag{3} \] This is the [actual geometric target formula](actual_matching_edge_geometric_target_polynomial.md). To use completeness, we must know that \(W\) really belongs to the marked holonomy group. For a half-twisted disk, that does not follow by simply assuming that the pure transport \(C\) is itself a group element. The next step supplies the actual words. ## 2. Recovering the group word at each half-twist sign Set \(S=I+H/2\), and let \(\mu\) be the based auxiliary meridian. The primitive-collar reconstruction in the [critical-scheme theorem](actual_augmented_plat_critical_scheme.md), at its complete endpoint \(J=-1\), gives the projective identity \[ \mu=C^{-1}S^\epsilon. \tag{4} \] The scalar in this identity is accounted for explicitly. The generic factor \((P^{-1}-I)^\epsilon\) specializes through \[ P^{-1}-I=-2S, \] and the recorded factor \(h_J^{-\epsilon}=(-2)^{-\epsilon}\) cancels it. Any remaining central lift sign does not affect conjugation. Thus (4) represents the primitive meridian rather than a substituted half-longitude. Direct multiplication gives \[ SBS^{-1}=A,\qquad S^{-1}BS=BAB^{-1}. \tag{5} \] Substituting \(C=\mu^{-1}S^\epsilon\) into \(B_{\mathrm{out}}=CBC^{-1}\) yields \[ B_{\mathrm{out}}= \begin{cases} \mu^{-1}B\mu,&\epsilon=0,\\ \mu^{-1}A\mu,&\epsilon=+1,\\ \mu^{-1}BAB^{-1}\mu,&\epsilon=-1. \end{cases} \tag{6} \] Every line is an actual based holonomy word in the same complete manifold. The common basepaths of \(A,B,\mu\) come from the original threading convention. Therefore \(W=B^{-1}B_{\mathrm{out}}\) is a group element for every retained sign. Nothing requires \(S\) itself to belong to that group. Changing a determinant-one lift sign cannot change whether the corresponding projective element is elliptic or parabolic. ## 3. Completeness rules out a ratio greater than one The certified metric is complete, and its universal developing cover is hyperbolic three-space. Its holonomy acts by deck transformations and hence freely: no nonidentity element fixes an interior point. Suppose \(c>1\). Equation (3) gives \(-2<\operatorname{Tr}W<2\). The determinant-one matrix then has distinct eigenvalues \(e^{i\theta},e^{-i\theta}\), with \(0<\theta<\pi\). Its projective action is a nontrivial rotation about the geodesic joining its two ideal fixed points. That rotation fixes the interior points of its axis, contradicting the free deck action. Consequently \(c\le1\), which proves (1). This argument uses the actual marked word (6). It needs no additional conjectural packing inequality. It also explains the role of the hypothesis: an abstract rectangle does not supply a deck transformation, so the same contradiction would not be available. At equality, the target is parabolic rather than the identity. In the chosen lift, \[ W=\begin{pmatrix} 8b^2-4b+1&4b^2\\ 16b^2&8b^2+4b+1 \end{pmatrix}. \] When \(c=1\), equation (2) gives \(b=-i/2\), and \[ W+I=\begin{pmatrix}2i&-1\\-4&-2i\end{pmatrix}\ne0, \qquad (W+I)^2=0. \] A nontrivial parabolic transformation has no interior fixed point, so completeness does not exclude this case. A strict inequality would require another argument about this particular word. ## 4. Consequence for the spectral target For every crossing circle covered by the complete marked certificate, \[ \begin{array}{ll} c<1:&\operatorname{Tr}W<-2,\\ c=1:&\operatorname{Tr}W=-2. \end{array} \] Thus the target is either real and outside the physical Casimir interval \([-2,2]\), or at its parabolic endpoint. The formal branch \(c>1\) still exists in the local algebraic four-parabolic relation, but it cannot be the complete geometry with these marked identifications. The conclusion concerns the trace, not every entry of a surrounding operator. It does not place all physical rows in a favorable support domain, identify the surrounding continuant state, or prove that a contour contribution survives. Those are separate analytical tasks. The [focused calculation](../experiments/audit_actual_matching_circle_rectangle_bound.py) checks the scalar cancellation, the three based words, the trace and the nonidentity endpoint matrix through sixteen exact identities; the free-deck argument above proves the general geometric restriction.

title: The matching-edge target gauge and its completed projector pairs
status: Exact regular block; native norms retained
text: # The matching-edge target gauge and its completed projector pairs Follow-up: the [native-energy theorem](actual_matching_edge_native_projector_energy.md) now gives the column measures and polynomial relative derivative costs for these completed operators. Their explicit magnetic energy can be exponential; its sharp use in the joint contraction remains open. 30 October 2026. The remaining scalar target normalization in the exact four-port block is the actual Casimir projector normalization times a regular face factor. Its universal physical scale cancels the cup bend. Pairing the two colliding target channels BEFORE specialization gives a regular Hermite block with explicitly controlled scalar jets. The native norms of the completed projectors and their derivatives remain to be estimated. This theorem neither makes the root channels orthogonal in a positive metric nor bounds a surrounding contraction. ## 1. Exact objects and the generic norm Use the original conventions of the [marked four-port block](actual_matching_edge_marked_four_port_block.md). Put d=N-1, zeta=q exp(t), q=exp(pi i/N), Q=zeta^2, and 0<=g<=d, E=2g, n=d-g, L=N zeta^(-d^2), pV=L p_d, ellV=pV^-1. The canonical ordinary channel cup p_(2g) has first coefficient one. Let W_g=W_dd^(2g), and retain its genuine categorical dual D(W_g)=p_(2g)^T W_g^T(ellV^T tensor ellV^T)P, N_g=W_g D(W_g), D(W_g)W_g=theta_g I_(2g+1). (1) These are generic rational identities, including high g. The last scalar follows from covariance and the generic highest-weight basis. No root value of theta_g is inverted. Let Omega be the original generic two-physical-head Casimir. Its distinct generic eigenvalues are lambda_g=zeta^(2g+1)+zeta^(-2g-1), 0<=g<=d, Pi_g=product_(h!=g)(Omega-lambda_h I)/(lambda_g-lambda_h). (2) The Clebsch images are independent because their eigenvalues differ, and sum_g(2g+1)=N^2. Thus they exhaust the generic tensor product. Consequently N_g=theta_g Pi_g as an identity of ACTUAL operators. The exact scalar is theta_g=(-1)^(d-g) zeta^(2d^2-g^2)/N^2 *[d+g+1]!/([d-g]![2g+1]!). (3) Here is a direct proof from the original matrix, without a quoted theta or quantum-group norm formula. In physical degree d the entry of the bent tensor S_(2g) at (d,0,0,d) is the previously derived chi X. Undoing the physical bend gives (N_g)_(d,0)=zeta^[2g(g-d)] F_d^2 / (L^2 F_(d-g)^2 F_(2g)), (4) where the two indices in (4) are the first physical magnetic index in that degree-d block. In particular its row d means (d,0), and its column zero means (0,d). The product of the original lower offdiagonals of that tridiagonal block is product_(r=0)^(d-1) zeta^-N(1-Q^(r+1))^2 =zeta^(-Nd) F_d^2. The extreme adjugate entry of zI-Omega therefore gives (Pi_g)_(d,0)=zeta^(-Nd)F_d^2/chi'(lambda_g), chi(z)=product_(h=0)^d(z-lambda_h). (5) This adjugate identity is the unique lower path through a tridiagonal matrix; it also follows by induction on its size. The elementary factorization of eigenvalue differences yields chi'(lambda_g)=(zeta-zeta^-1)^(2d)(-1)^(d-g) [d-g]![d+g+1]!/[2g+1]. (6) Divide (4) by (5). Since F_k=zeta^[k(k-1)/2](1-Q)^k[k]!, the residual exponent before inserting L is -g^2. Substituting L=N zeta^-d^2 proves (3). ## 2. The actual target scalar becomes a face factor The exact target product of the preceding block theorem is h_g=1/(b_(2g)J_(d-g)V_(d-g)) =(-1)^d zeta^(g^2+d) [g]!^2[d-g]!^2[2g+1]![2d+1]! / ([d]!^2[d+g+1]!^2). Define the already proved regular face factor and a universal scalar D_g=(-1)^g[N][g]!^2[d-g]!/[d+g+1]!, beta_N=zeta^(2d^2+d)/N^2 *[2d+1]!/([N][d]!^2). (7) Multiplication of the ACTUAL products gives exactly h_g theta_g=beta_N D_g. (8) At the root D_g(q)=1 for every g, while beta_N(q)=(-1)^d q^(d+2)/N^2. (9) All these root-zero cancellations are performed generically. Both D_g and beta_N/beta_N(q) are holomorphic units on a uniform disk of radius c/[N^2(1+log N)], and every fixed relative jet has polynomial cost, by their explicit root-unit factorial products. For clarity, let R be the ACTUAL last-to-first cyclic tensor turn (R Psi)(u,v,w,z)=(-1)^d zeta^(d-2u) Psi(v,w,z,u), B(K)=K(pV tensor pV)P. Equations (1)--(8) give the exact typed target identity h_g T_(2g)=beta_N R B(D_g Pi_g). (10) It holds at generic zeta through the entire range 0<=g<=d. The physical reversal and odd-d turn remain in (10). At the root the norm of B on Hilbert--Schmidt matrices is N^2, and the norm of R is one. Equation (9) cancels that physical scale. Fixed generic derivatives of the combined map beta_N R B have only polynomial cost. This removes its scalar factorial cost; it says nothing by itself about the operator norms of the Pi_g. ## 3. Pair before taking the normal Fix the original folded row a, and put F_ag=G_ag D_g, G_ag=(-1)^d S_ag/[N], F_ag(q)=R_N(a,g)>0. For a paired target choose 0<=g<g'=d-g and set Q_g=Pi_g+Pi_g', M_g=(Omega-lambda_g' I)Q_g, H_ag=(F_ag-F_ag')/(lambda_g-lambda_g'). (11) Each of the three quantities in (11) is holomorphic at the root. For Q_g, the quadratic cluster factor (z-lambda_g)(z-lambda_g') is coprime there to the product of the other cluster factors. Bezout gives its spectral projector as a polynomial in Omega with coefficients regular at q. This is the generic sum in (11), so it remains regular through the collision. The polynomial identity product_h(Omega-lambda_h I)=0 holds generically and hence at q; in particular Q_g(q)^2=Q_g(q), M_g(q)^2=0. (12) The odd simple target g=d/2 is kept separately and its Pi_g is already regular. No positivity or Hermitian self-adjointness is asserted for any of these projectors. For H_ag, the numerator vanishes because the positive scalar partners have the same root value and D_g(q)=D_g'(q)=1. The denominator has a SIMPLE zero, with its actual TARGET convention lambda_g-lambda_g' =-(zeta^s-zeta^-s)(zeta^N-zeta^-N), s=d-2g, partial_t(lambda_g-lambda_g')(0)=2N Delta_g, Delta_g=q^(2g+1)-q^(-2g-1). (13) This sign is opposite to the compiler's small-index minus large-index gap: its channel index is m=d-g. It must not be inferred from a root-only eigenvalue formula. The exact regular paired identity is F_ag Pi_g+F_ag' Pi_g' =F_ag' Q_g+H_ag M_g. (14) Thus at the root it is R_N(a,g)Q_g(q)+H_ag(q)M_g(q). The nilpotent Hermite term is retained; equality of the two scalar root values does not remove it. There are uniform scalar jet estimates, for every fixed r, |[t^r]F_ag|<=C_r P_N^r R_N(a,g), |[t^r]H_ag|<=C_r P_N^(r+1) R_N(a,g), P_N=N^2(1+log N). (15) Indeed the first bound is the existing scalar/face theorem. On a slightly smaller common disk, (F_ag-F_ag')/t has size at most C P_N R_N(a,g) by Cauchy's formula and its zero at the center. The function (lambda_g-lambda_g')/t is a unit on that disk, uniformly bounded below: its root magnitude is 4N sin(pi s/N)>=8, and its two elementary factors have controlled relative changes there. Dividing and applying Cauchy again proves the second bound. Both numerator and gap derivatives are included. ## 4. The resulting source interface and its remaining estimate The full weighted recoupling inside the block is now sum_(g=0)^d G_ag h_g T_(2g) =beta_N R B[ sum_(g<d-g)(F_ag' Q_g+H_ag M_g) + the odd simple term F_(a,d/2) Pi_(d/2) ]. (16) The last term is included only when d is even. Its a is still the original folded row label. Every term on the right is regular BEFORE the whole-network first normal is taken. Its first derivative uses only Q_g,M_g and their FIRST generic-q derivatives. The scalar H_ag' already retains the necessary second derivatives of the original F weights. Equation (16) is equivalent to the prior Taylor-two Laurent extraction, with the partner cancellation performed explicitly rather than left between separate singular target terms. There is also a complete cancellation of the original universal scalar. Retain u_a=rho_a/rho_a(q) from the marked block theorem, put v_N=beta_N/beta_N(q), and define the ACTUAL physical reshuffle A(t)=B(t)^-1 R(t) B(t). The original measure identity and (9) give h0_a gamma_a^-1 rho_a(q) beta_N(q)=k_a N, h0_a K_a(t)=k_a N u_a(t)v_N(t) A(t) E_a(t), (17) where E_a denotes the regular completed sum in square brackets in (16). Every factor in (17) is regular. At the root A is an isometry for the Hilbert--Schmidt norm: B is N^2 times a unitary map, R is unitary, and B^-1 is N^-2 times a unitary map. Its fixed jets have polynomial cost. The equalities use the original physical cups, not a new metric on the internal channels. For a concrete upper bound define, in the original physical basis, J_C^(1)=max_(r=0,1)||[t^r]C||, J_g^cl=max_(r=0,1)(||[t^r]Q_g||_HS+||[t^r]M_g||_HS), J_mid=max_(r=0,1)||[t^r]Pi_(d/2)||_HS (only when d is even). Using (15),(17) and |nu_N|=N/sin(pi/N) gives |h0_a omega_a^epsilon Z_Delta| <=C k_a sin(pi/N) P_N^2 J_C^(1) *[sum_(g<d-g) R_N(a,g)J_g^cl + R_N(a,d/2)J_mid]. (19) The last summand is again omitted when d is odd. A weighted Cauchy inequality can be applied to this positive scalar sum, with these specified native cluster costs. title: The original exceptional operator as a continuant period
status: Exact operator period and retained normal poles
text: # The original exceptional operator as a continuant period 30 October 2026. The completed matching block has an exact generic contour representation whose entries are original forward and backward continuants. It retains the paired double poles, moving-q normals, physical target order and finite propagation. This separates an actual operator period from evaluation of its scalar polynomial at a classical trace. No geometric saddle contribution or sharp complementary contraction estimate is asserted. ## 1. The original generic matrix and its actual spectrum Put d=N-1 and use zeta=q exp(h), q=exp(pi i/N). In a physical total-degree block 0<=t<=d, the original Casimir J_t(zeta) has diagonal A_r, upper U_r and lower L_r, r=0,...,t: Q=zeta^2, A_r=zeta^-1 Q^(r-t)(1-Q^(N-r))(1-Q^r) +zeta^(-2d-1)Q^r(1-Q^(N-t+r))(1-Q^(t-r)) +zeta^(2d+1)Q^-t+zeta^(-2d-1)Q^t, U_r=zeta^-N Q^(2r+1-t)(1-Q^(N-r-1))(1-Q^(t-r)), L_r=zeta^-N(1-Q^(N-t+r))(1-Q^(r+1)). (1) The offdiagonals are indexed 0<=r<t. These are the actual entries proved in [the physical generic-jet theorem](actual_q_hahn_physical_generic_jet_bound.md). In particular U and L are NOT identified away from the root. All internal offdiagonals are nonzero at q. The actual generic high-degree adapter identifies total degree 2d-t with this same matrix, with the translated physical indices; no new norm or complex conjugation is imposed. Its generic characteristic polynomial is chi_t(zeta,z)=product_(m=0)^t (z-lambda_m(zeta)), lambda_m(zeta)=zeta^(2N-2m-1)+zeta^(-2N+2m+1). (2) This follows from the original normalized Clebsch columns for m=0,...,t and their distinct generic eigenvalues. Their generic source identity then extends (2) to q. The target label used in the recoupling is g=d-m, so (2) is exactly the target Casimir zeta^(2g+1)+zeta^(-2g-1), with its original moving-q derivative. At q the only repeated eigenvalues are the pairs m and d-m when both occur in this block. Their multiplicity is two. An odd-level middle label is simple. An unreduced tridiagonal matrix has one-dimensional eigenspaces: its first coordinate determines an eigenvector recursively and cannot vanish. Therefore every paired node here has a genuine Jordan block of size two, rather than two independent eigenspaces. ## 2. Exact Green entries with both continuants retained Define the prefix and suffix determinants P_r(z)=det(zI-J_t[0,...,r-1]), P_0=1, S_r(z)=det(zI-J_t[r,...,t]), S_(t+1)=1. (3) All quantities retain their dependence on zeta. They satisfy the original forward and backward determinant recurrences. For example P_(r+1)=(z-A_r)P_r-U_(r-1)L_(r-1)P_(r-1). For z outside the actual spectrum, set R_t(zeta,z)=(zI-J_t)^-1. The exact entries are (R_t)_(u,v)= (product_(r=u)^(v-1) U_r) P_u S_(v+1)/chi_t, u<=v, (product_(r=v)^(u-1) L_r) P_v S_(u+1)/chi_t, v<=u. (4) Empty products are one, so the two formulas agree on the diagonal. Expanding a tridiagonal cofactor proves (4): the intervening chain uses exactly the indicated upper or lower entries, and the two remaining blocks supply the prefix and suffix. Equivalently direct multiplication by zI-J_t verifies (4) using (3). No root-only reflection is differentiated to obtain the backward factor. ## 3. The exact generic operator period and its bandwidth Let p_a(zeta,z) and D_a(zeta) be the original polynomial and face factor in [the generic target identity](actual_matching_edge_geometric_target_polynomial.md). For the original folded range 0<=a<=floor(d/2), their coefficients are holomorphic near q after the displayed common face zero is canceled. The completed operator before the fixed physical bend and pivotal turn is E_a(zeta)=D_a(zeta)^-1 p_a(zeta,Omega(zeta)). (5) Fix one contour Gamma enclosing ALL the root spectral nodes, for example the positively oriented circle |z|=3. For zeta in a sufficiently small neighborhood of q, the same contour encloses every moving node and meets none. On each physical block, E_(a,t)(zeta) =D_a(zeta)^-1/(2pi i) integral_Gamma p_a(zeta,z) R_t(zeta,z) dz. (6) This follows either by Cauchy's formula on the generic eigenspaces, then holomorphic continuation, or by expanding the resolvent at infinity and taking the coefficient of z^-1. Thus (6) is valid at the paired root WITHOUT deleting its double poles. Substitution of (4) is an exact single spectral-period representation of every native magnetic matrix entry. The original polynomial has degree a. Since J_t is tridiagonal, (E_(a,t)(zeta))_(u,v)=0 if |u-v|>a. (7) This is a generic identity, so every fixed moving-q derivative has the SAME bandwidth. Equivalently (6) has exact cancellation outside this band. This assertion is about the actual target physical coordinates BEFORE the recorded bend and pivotal turn; it does not silently permute the original outside ports. The full source substitution retains beta_N times the original bend and turn, the row factor and half-twist, and the whole-source marked normal, exactly as in the completed target theorem. Those factors have not been absorbed into a chosen resolvent norm. ## 4. Genuine moving-q normals and the reduced pole budget Differentiate in h with z FIXED. The exact identity is partial_h R_t=R_t (partial_h J_t) R_t. Consequently the first normal of (6) is partial_h E_(a,t) =-(partial_h D_a)/D_a *E_(a,t) +D_a^-1/(2pi i) integral_Gamma [(partial_h p_a)R_t+p_a R_t(partial_h J_t)R_t] dz. (8) The partial derivative of p_a retains every generic-q coefficient. The derivative of J_t is the derivative of (1), including the distinct generic upper and lower entries. Formula (8) therefore includes moving spectral nodes and moving generalized eigenspaces, not merely a derivative of the scalar root value. There is a useful exact reduction at a paired node lambda. Let Q(h) be its analytic two-dimensional cluster projector, and let its two actual analytic eigenbranches be lambda_1(h),lambda_2(h). At h=0 put Q=Q(0), M=(J_t(q)-lambda)Q, M^2=0. Then the root resolvent on this cluster is R_cluster=Q/(z-lambda)+M/(z-lambda)^2. (9) The apparent fourth-order pole in R(partial_h J)R vanishes. Indeed differentiate the exact cluster identity (J-lambda_1)(J-lambda_2)Q(h)=0 and sandwich it by Q. It gives Q J' M+M J' Q=(lambda_1'+lambda_2')M, M J' M=0. (10) The second equation follows by multiplication by M. Thus the same-cluster contribution to R J' R is exactly Q J' Q/(z-lambda)^2 +(lambda_1'+lambda_2')M/(z-lambda)^3. (11) Terms between different spectral clusters remain in (8); they must not be discarded. They contain the actual motion of the cluster projectors. The source derivative of the paired gap is lambda_j'-lambda_(d-j)'=-2N(q^(2j+1)-q^(-2j-1)), in convention (2). More generally the r-th moving-q derivative of the resolvent has pole order at most r+2 at a paired node and at most r+1 at a simple node. To see this WITHOUT assuming diagonalizability at the root, the exact analytic cluster resolvent is R_cluster(h,z)= [(z-lambda_1(h))Q(h)+(J(h)-lambda_2(h))Q(h)] /[(z-lambda_1(h))(z-lambda_2(h))]. (12) Each h derivative increases the specialized denominator pole order by at most one. All numerators and cluster projectors in (12) are holomorphic. The corresponding scalar spectral derivatives needed in an r-th operator normal consequently have order at most r+1, with the actual q derivatives still retained. In particular the first normal needs scalar spectral derivatives only through order two, consistent with the prior Taylor-two calculation. These are exact pole budgets, not size bounds on the cluster projectors. ## 5. Scalar continuation is distinct from contour contribution The [source-polynomial root theorem](actual_matching_edge_racah_root_location.md) gives a canonical Log p_a and a leading scalar action throughout C minus [2,infinity). This is a statement about p_a, not about R_t. The latter has the actual nodes of (2), all in [-2,2] at q, including their double poles. In particular a target below -2 is off the root spectrum. A general target in (-2,2) lies in its spectral interval, among nodes that become dense as N grows. Any deformation of (6) must avoid those actual poles or account for their residues. The scalar's zero-free continuation does not permit deleting them. The exact numerator in (4) is where selected forward/backward boundary estimates can enter. A proof of a geometric contribution must still analyze that numerator together with chi_t, the fixed spectral contour, and the actual surrounding coherent state. It cannot replace p_a(Omega) by p_a(lambda_geometric) pointwise. Equations (4),(6),(8),(12) expose that remaining operator problem while preserving its original source and every required normal. Audit: [actual Green entries, contour coefficients, normal poles and bandwidth](../experiments/audit_actual_matching_edge_continuant_operator_period.py). The operator-period identity includes no contour deformation or scalar-to-operator asymptotic.

title: The original cross-central Green kernel has a selected spectral action
status: Actual Green action and generic jets on strict support
text: # The original cross-central Green kernel has a selected spectral action 30 October 2026. The exact exceptional operator period now has a source-selected leading Green-kernel action when its two physical rows lie strictly on opposite sides of the midpoint. The actual characteristic denominator, all phases and both level parities are retained. On the anti-diagonal the original Green entry is strictly negative for every real spectral parameter below -2. Every fixed genuine generic-q jet costs only a polynomial relative to that root Green entry on the strict fixed compacts below. This is an integrand theorem. It neither deforms the fixed contour nor proves that its geometric critical point contributes. ## 1. Exact original phases and the anti-diagonal sign Use the original root matrix J_t of [the continuant operator period](actual_matching_edge_continuant_operator_period.md), with 0<=t<=d=N-1. Let 0<=u<=v<=t, q=exp(pi i/N), theta=pi/N, and Delta_m(z)=det(J_[m]-zI), D_t(z)=det(J_t-zI) =product_(h=0)^t [2cos((2h+1)theta)-z]. The original upper and lower entries agree AT THE ROOT and equal U_r=-a_r exp[i(2r+1-t)theta], a_r=4sin((t-r)theta)sin((r+1)theta)>0. (1) The root reversal is J_t reversed=conjugate(J_t). Thus the trailing determinant of size t-v is conjugate(Delta_(t-v)(conjugate z)). Substitution in the exact Green formula gives (zI-J_t)^-1_(u,v) =-exp[i theta(v-u)(u+v-t)] *product_(r=u)^(v-1) a_r *Delta_u(z) conjugate(Delta_(t-v)(conjugate z))/D_t(z). (2) The single minus sign is important. The upper product has sign (-1)^(v-u), the two zI-J continuants have signs (-1)^u and (-1)^(t-v), and the full characteristic determinant has sign (-1)^(t+1). Their ratio is -1, independent of every label and level parity. Also sum_(r=u)^(v-1)(2r+1-t)=(v-u)(u+v-t) exactly. For a real z<-2 the denominator D_t(z) is positive. If u+v=t, the phase in (2) is one and its two prefix lengths agree. Hence (zI-J_t)^-1_(u,t-u) =-product_(r=u)^(t-u-1) a_r *|Delta_u(z)|^2/D_t(z)<0, 0<=u<=floor(t/2). (3) Strictness is exact, not asymptotic. For u=0 the empty determinant is one. For u>0, the already proved positive imaginary part of the physical half-prefix implies Delta_u(z)!=0 for every real z; its proof needs only u<=floor(t/2), not a complete-channel assumption. See the explicit extension in the [physical generic-jet theorem](actual_q_hahn_physical_generic_jet_bound.md). Equation (3) is the sign of the original matrix entry. It does not replace the surrounding state or mark by a positive functional. ## 2. A fully normalized leading Green action Take actual integer sequences with t/N->tau, u/N->nu, v/N->omega, 0<nu<tau/2<omega<tau<1. (4) Uniformity is on compact subsets of this strict real domain. The row indices remain physical integers. They are not analytically continued to complex magnetic coordinates. Use the selected prefix action proved in [the original off-spectrum prefix theorem](https://github.com/sashakolpakov/murakamis_dream/blob/19d5b911bc409486f0e72b51a876a6a2bc70ee02/notes/actual_casimir_off_spectrum_prefix_action.md): A_tau(s)=-4 exp[i pi(2s-tau)] sin(pi(tau-s))sin(pi s), w=2-z, S_(tau,b)(z)=integral_0^b Log[(w+2A_tau(s)+sqrt(w(w+4A_tau(s))))/2] ds. (5) The logarithm and square root are selected at negative real spectral infinity. Write S^#_(tau,b)(z)=conjugate(S_(tau,b)(conjugate z)), which is a holomorphic function on the conjugate prefix domain. Define beta_1=pi(1-tau+2nu), beta_2=pi(1-tau+2(tau-omega)). Both lie strictly between zero and pi. Let U be the component containing the real interval z<-2 of {Re[exp(-i beta_1/2)(2-z)]>0} intersect {Re[exp(+i beta_2/2)(2-z)]>0} minus [-2,2]. (6) In particular U contains a complex neighborhood of every compact real interval below -2. Every compact subset of U is in the two finite prefix domains for all sufficiently large N. Their actual determinants are nonzero there, as is D_t. Use (2) to mark the logarithm of minus the Green entry: retain its literal phase theta(v-u)(u+v-t), the positive logarithms of a_r, the two selected prefix logarithms, and the denominator product logarithms continued from their positive values at z<-2. Then N^-1 Log[-(zI-J_t)^-1_(u,v)] -> G_(tau,nu,omega)(z), G_(tau,nu,omega)(z) =i pi(omega-nu)(nu+omega-tau) +integral_nu^omega log[4sin(pi(tau-s))sin(pi s)] ds +S_(tau,nu)(z)+S^#_(tau,tau-omega)(z) -integral_0^tau Log[2cos(2pi s)-z] ds. (7) Convergence is locally uniform on U, with every fixed z derivative. The proof uses the actual identity (2): each prefix limit is (5), the middle positive product has a smooth Riemann-sum limit on the strict interval in (4), and the EXACT denominator product has the last integral in (7). All its roots remain in [-2,2], so on a compact of U that Riemann sum and its spectral derivatives converge uniformly. No unknown function of z can be added to (7). The normalized logarithm is an accumulated source phase, not the principal argument of the scalar Green entry. On the anti-diagonal omega=tau-nu, (7) is real for z<-2, in agreement with the exact negative sign (3). ## 3. The genuine generic-q Green normals have relative polynomial bounds Keep a fixed compact of the parameter and spectral domain (4),(6), and now use the original generic matrix J_t(q exp(h)), including its distinct upper and lower entries. Write R_uv(h,z) for its Green entry. For all sufficiently large N there are constants c,C>0, independent of N and the physical integer labels in this compact, such that |R_uv(h,z)/R_uv(0,z)|<=C, |R_uv(0,z)/R_uv(h,z)|<=C, |h|<=c N^-2. (8) In particular the generic entry is nonzero on this disk and |partial_h^r R_uv(0,z)| <=C_r N^(2r)|R_uv(0,z)| (9) for every fixed r. The inverse Green entry has the corresponding relative bound. These are upper bounds; no nonzero asymptotic amplitude for a particular normal is inferred. Here is a proof retaining the source factors. Each original generic entry in the physical tridiagonal block has h derivative O(N) for |h|<=c/N^2. Its finitely many exponent factors have size O(N), and their moduli are bounded on that disk. Fixed bandwidth therefore gives an operator-norm perturbation O(N|h|) in either prefix. At the root, the two prefix inverses on the chosen compact are uniformly bounded by the proved strict-half-prefix theorem and its conjugate. Thus their relative determinant factors are det(I+E), with ||E||<=C N|h|. For N large this is less than 1/2, and the trace logarithm gives |Log det(I+E)|<=C N^2 |h|. This bounds BOTH determinant ratios. The trailing generic prefix is perturbed as its own actual matrix; the root reflection is used only to establish its initial inverse bound, never differentiated. All intervening upper entries in the Green product are uniformly bounded away from zero at the root: the strict support has u/N>0 and v/N<tau, and both sine factors in (1) have fixed margins on that interval. Their individual logarithmic variations are O(N|h|), so their product and its inverse have the same exp[O(N^2|h|)] relative control. Finally the EXACT generic denominator is product_(m=0)^t[lambda_m(q exp(h))-z]. The spectral compact has positive distance from [-2,2]; each moving node varies by O(N|h|), so this denominator and its inverse satisfy the same relative bound. Combining these facts in the original generic Green formula proves (8). Cauchy's inequality on that very disk proves (9), retaining all numerator and spectral-node derivatives. ## 4. The original scalar integrand and its remaining contour problem Let a/N->alpha in (0,1/2]. The actual Casimir polynomial has the selected logarithmic limit Psi_alpha(z) from [the source root-location theorem](actual_matching_edge_racah_root_location.md). At the root the original face factor is D_a(q)=1. Thus, on the common domain just specified, the ACTUAL spectral integrand in the completed-operator formula has leading action Psi_alpha(z)+G_(tau,nu,omega)(z). (10) In particular its spectral stationarity equation is explicitly Psi_alpha'(z)+G_(tau,nu,omega)'(z)=0, G'(z)=-integral_0^nu [w(w+4A_tau(s))]^-1/2 ds -integral_0^(tau-omega) [w(w+4conjugate(A_tau(s)))]^-1/2 ds +integral_0^tau [2cos(2pi s)-z]^-1 ds. (11) The roots in (11) are those of (5) and its conjugate continuation, not newly chosen square roots. The denominator term is essential; it is fixed by the original finite characteristic polynomial. Equation (10) is an action for the real-physical-row INTEGRAND, not an asymptotic for the contour integral or for its surrounding coherent contraction. A deformation of the original fixed contour still has to retain every actual spectral pole and normal. Targets in (-2,2), midpoint prefixes, complex physical rows and relative amplitude expansions are outside the theorem here. The normal bound (9) does not assert that an individual normal has that action. Neither (3) nor (7) implies dominance of the real off-spectrum ray. There is also an explicit endpoint issue for a closed contour. A fixed contour enclosing the spectral interval can cross the scalar's limiting cut [2,infinity). A contour staying in that scalar slit may instead need an N-dependent closing segment approaching 2, between the largest Casimir node and the smallest scalar zero. Fixed-compact limits (7),(10), or the fixed-compact normal bound (9), do not control such a segment. Audit: [actual Green phases, strict anti-diagonal signs and selected logarithms](../experiments/audit_actual_matching_edge_cross_central_green_action.py). The theorem bounds the stated integrand and normals. It does not select a contour or prove a geometric contribution to the full source.

title: The actual degree cycle across the finite-head wall
status: Source-null ordered periods and exact boundary normal residues
text: # The actual degree cycle across the finite-head wall 30 October 2026. The specified generic exceptional lift can be used on a larger original physical-grid residue cycle by adding explicitly proved source-null local tori. This is a statement about PERIODS, not multivariable removability of its poles. Moving that enlarged cycle still meets genuine channel-row divisors. Their pole coefficients, their cotangent finite parts, and their first source-normal densities are calculated below with the actual lattice step and original complement retained. The theorem does not deform the whole cycle to the geometric saddle or prove a nonzero global coefficient. It supplies the exact boundary currents that such a deformation must retain. ## 1. The original meromorphic source at a chosen matching cut Use the [specified generic lift](actual_matching_edge_generic_deficient_operator_lift.md), with N>=3, d=N-1, L=2a, m=d-a, s=d-2a, and zeta=q0 exp(epsilon), q0=exp(pi i/N), P=pi i/Log zeta, lambda=2 Log zeta. In the upper ordered physical sector u<=v<=t_target<=d put h=v-u, ell=t_target-v, sigma=d-h, r=a-h. text: # A specified generic exceptional-operator lift at nonreal deficient degree 30 October 2026. The original generic exceptional polynomial has a source-preserving meromorphic lift to a nonreal deficient-degree neighborhood. It uses the actual LARGE-channel white numerators and an explicitly chosen moving-period factorial. Every fixed genuine q derivative has subexponential relative cost in shrinking folded-channel windows. At maximal folded channels the cost is polynomial, at both parities. The root value of this generic lift is exp(-2pi i v) times the earlier phase-canceled entire kernel, where v is the target input row. This integer character is one on the source lattice but is retained off it. Negative channel-row poles are genuine divisors of the generic lift. Neither a nonzero leading normal amplitude nor a nonzero transported global cycle is asserted. ## 1. Which generic operator and which source germ Fix N>=3, d=N-1, 0<=a<=floor(d/2), m=d-a, s=d-2a, and zeta=q0 exp(epsilon), q0=exp(pi i/N), Q=zeta^2.
