A has an interval black vertex u on edge slots (a,a+1,a+2), and an EXPOSED white marked cap elsewhere. B has an outer white vertex w on edge slots (0,k,E_B-1), so every other white block is in one of its two gaps. Give B the exposed mark at w. Match the three boundary labels in their displayed order; call them (a0,b0,c0). Remove u and w and glue their three edge ends IN ORDER. Concretely replace A's three-slot interval by B's whole edge row, map the three old A contacts to a+(0,k,E_B-1), move subsequent A slots by E_B-3, and map every B slot e to a+e. Keep the other vertices. Black A blocks surround or avoid the replacement interval; the inserted black blocks are noncrossing within it. The old white blocks are mapped monotonically, and new white blocks lie strictly in the two previously empty contact gaps. Thus both new partitions remain noncrossing. The original p/ell matchings give a literal new Morse word. A's exposed marked cap remains exposed; no inserted white block can surround its contacts. All statements below use that point, not a bare mark moved to a nested cap. The two merged edge exponents ADD. The new edge has ONE coupon R^(e_A+e_B)L_j, not the product of the two old circle coupons. No L_j^2 has been substituted or inverted at the root. ## 2. A genuine invariant output column, not a guessed scalar exterior Fix generic zeta near q=exp(pi i/N), and the canonical ordinary Q_j tensors, duals and actual edge constants of the first-normal theorem. Assume first that every local ordinary triple is triangular. Remove ONLY B's outer white row D(Theta_c0,b0,a0). Contract every other ordinary vertex in B. The resulting column is Y_B(zeta) in Q_a0 tensor Q_b0 tensor Q_c0. (1) It is a genuine homogeneous invariant. For a direct proof, the noncrossing black source is built by inserting interval invariant triples, hence is globally invariant. Every white block other than w can then be removed in its innermost interval order, by a genuine ordinary invariant covector. All blocks are in w's two gaps. What remains are its three ordered output ports, with no intervening cap, braid, or free tensor permutation. The ordinary invariant space has dimension ONE at generic zeta, and its normalized Theta_a0,b0,c0 has corner (2a0,b0+c0-a0,0) equal to one. Every local coefficient is regular at the root. Consequently Y_B=alpha_B Theta_a0,b0,c0, alpha_B=(Y_B)_(2a0,b0+c0-a0,0), (2) with alpha_B a HOLomorphic finite function, computed by the open magnetic contraction. This is an all-entry identity of that source column and can be paired with an arbitrary exterior row. No invariant or regularity assumption about A's exterior row is needed. Let Xi_A,Xi_B,Xi_new be the complete ordinary networks. The fully normalized ordinary theta is Xi_theta=D(Theta_c0,b0,a0)Theta_a0,b0,c0. Then (2) gives exact generic identities Xi_B=alpha_B Xi_theta, Xi_new=alpha_B Xi_A, Xi_theta Xi_new=Xi_A Xi_B. (3) The scalar alpha_B is not defined by contracting the unknown final invariant: it is the explicit open corner in (2). In particular its regularity is proved BEFORE division by Xi_theta. If the boundary triple is nontriangular, the actual invariant column (1) is zero and the new source is identically zero. Nontriangular interior vertices are likewise zero; they are not omitted as a semisimple convention. ## 3. The denominator has an exact root order and source normalization Write a,b,c for the boundary labels in this section and set J=a+b+c, r=b+c-a, r1=a+b-c, r2=a+c-b, F_l=(zeta^2;zeta^2)_l. The independently proved finite Vandermonde evaluation is Xi_theta=(-1)^r1 zeta^[2c-r1(r-1)] F_(2b)F_r2 F_(J+1) /[(1-zeta^2)F_r F_(2a)F_r1 F_(2c)]. (4) All denominator factorials have index <N. Thus ord_q Xi_theta=1 if J>=d, and 0 if J<d, d=N-1. (5) The numerator contains at most one factor 1-zeta^(2N), since J+1<2N. Formula (4) applies to odd simple and even/odd paired axes without separating away their original source factors. Let F_A,F_B,F_new be the ordinary GENERIC physical closures in the chosen regular Hopf lift, and use C,S as in the first-normal theorem. The new constants are exactly C_new=C_A C_B/C_theta, C_theta=product_(boundary j)h0_j gamma_j, S_new=product_(vertices of A except u)s_v *product_(vertices of B except w)s_v. (6) Boundary edge twists are added, so their omega factors occur in C_new with the correct sum. Both removed source factors are the actual s_abc and s_cba. In particular the cross-multiplied identity is F_theta F_new=F_A F_B, F_theta=C_theta s_abc s_cba Xi_theta. (7) This keeps ALL phases, G factors, h0 first normals and fixed gamma units. Each remains present exactly once on a new edge. The source identity is generic and does not divide by nilpotent root operators. For J>=d the actual s_abc(0),s_cba(0) are nonzero, Xi_theta has a simple zero, and F_theta'(0)=nu_N Z_theta!=0, nu_N=2N(-1)^N/(q-q^(-1)), Z_theta=N^2 k_a k_b k_c s_r s_r1 s_r2/s_(J-d) *R_N(a,b,c)^2>0. (8) Here R_N is the already proved positive finite source partition, not an assumed quantum 6j. Equation (8) is a fully explicit boundary weight. It may be exponential and must not be called a polynomial normalization cost. ## 4. Exact fixed-normal gluing and order addition Each exposed physical closure is F_G=D_N z_G, where D_N=(-1)^d[N]_zeta has its simple zero at q and z_G is the actual regular open scalar. For a SUPPORTED boundary (J>=d), equation(7) therefore gives a holomorphic identity z_new=z_A z_B/z_theta, because z_theta(q)=Z_theta>0. In particular the original raw marked scalars, with no transported or repeated mark, obey Z_new=Z_A Z_B/Z_theta. (9) This formula holds even if one of the pieces has a zero raw scalar or a retained unsaturated marked-white current. Those pieces are the complete exposed original sources, not just a selected leading saddle. All such terms are included in their z_G. For nonzero generic ordinary spin networks, (3) gives v(Xi_new)=v(Xi_A)+v(Xi_B)-v(Xi_theta), (10) where v is the exact order at q. The regular alpha_B proves this without assigning a first-nonzero convention to the original source. For supported seams and nonzero physical closure germs one similarly has v(F_new)=v(F_A)+v(F_B)-1. Thus two genuine simple physical zeros give a simple zero after sewing. If a piece has higher order, its fixed first-normal value vanishes and (9) retains that zero. Any original external lines remain explicit. If K_G=chi_G Z_G, then the corresponding relation has the extra factor chi_new chi_theta/(chi_A chi_B); it cannot be suppressed without the actual framing/normalization certificate. ## 5. All boundary channels, including the unsaturated current The ordinary column (2) and identity (3) hold at EVERY triangular folded boundary label. For J<d, Xi_theta(q) is a unit. The two removed source factors s_abc(q),s_cba(q) are zero; it is not valid to divide root marked scalars by Z_theta=0. Instead the exact formula is Z_new=C_new/nu_N *d/dt|0 {S_new(t) Xi_A(t) alpha_B(t)}. (11) All local source factors in S_new are defined by actual finite Clebsch/cup contractions and their explicit first jets. Thus (11) retains the local unsaturated source normals, including a local marked-white current inherited from A. It does not infer them from the zero closed values of the removed boundary vertices. Using alpha_B=Xi_B/Xi_theta here is harmless because this particular ordinary denominator is a root unit. For full circles, the shared boundary triple must be summed ONCE, and its three labels remain correlated. If Z_A(a,b,c),Z_B(a,b,c) denote the complete coherent interior sums with those labels fixed, the whole new scalar is exactly sum_(a+b+c>=d) Z_A(a,b,c) Z_B(a,b,c)/Z_theta(a,b,c). (12) There is no omitted unsaturated correction in this COMPLETE-circle operation. The [exposed six-port pruning theorem](https://github.com/sashakolpakov/murakamis_dream/blob/19d5b911bc409486f0e72b51a876a6a2bc70ee02/notes/actual_exposed_six_port_complete_circle_pruning.md) proves it before the exterior or mark acts: remove B's three boundary coupons and every ordinary cap other than its omitted outer vertex. The remaining physical six-head column is a regular generic invariant, so its root lies in the actual saturated S_N. The three boundary coupons commute with those disjoint cap removals and can be applied last. Their full complete-circle product annihilates S_N when J<d. This proves that the exact expression(11) vanishes as a WHOLE source; it does not set its local source derivatives to zero. Nontriangles are zero as well. The positive denominator in (12) does not make its numerator a square: the two actual packets need not be conjugates. A physical mirror/reflection identity would still be needed before asserting a positive graph norm. ## 6. An explicit primitive cube corner, with three finite sum variables For the genuine ordered cube use black blocks (0,1,2),(3,4,11),(5,9,10),(6,7,8) and ordinary white blocks (1,8,9),(2,3,7),(4,5,6), leaving outer white (0,10,11) OPEN. Put j_0=a,j_10=b,j_11=c, fix boundary magnetic colors r_0=2a,r_10=b+c-a,r_11=0, and write J_v for the sum of edge labels at the indicated vertex. Define B0=j_1+j_2-a, B1=j_3+j_4+c, B2=j_5+j_9+a-c. For free magnetic integers u,v,w set r_1=u, r_2=B0-u, r_3=v, r_4=B1-v, r_5=w, r_9=B2-w, r_8=J_(1,8,9)-B2-u+w, r_7=J_(2,3,7)-B0+u-v, r_6=J_(4,5,6)-B1+v-w. (13) The remaining black magnetic equation holds identically by boundary weight conservation. Therefore alpha_cube is exactly the triple sum over (13) of the FOUR canonical black Theta entries and the THREE genuine white dual Theta entries. Require 0<=r_e<=2j_e on EVERY edge; otherwise the term is zero. Each individual entry is the explicit finite ordinary coefficient(6),(7) of the first-normal theorem, including its phase. There is no extra closed physical source or unknown inverse frame in this formula. This is a usable all-N primitive open-column scalar. The full column is alpha_cube Theta_boundary by (2), so the triple sum is not just one arbitrarily chosen bad entry. At spin one its exact evaluation is g^3(D^3-9D^2+29D-32), recovering the independently proved generic flow model. A positive high-fold evaluation or a large-N nonzero estimate for the general triple sum remains open; absolute values of its summands would discard precisely the coherence to be proved. ## 7. An exact order-two counterexample to a graph-only criterion At N=5, d=4 and M=2, take two actual ordered cubes. In A give its interval black edges (0,1,2) labels (1,1,1); every other edge has label2. In B give its outer white edges (0,10,11) labels (1,1,1); every other edge has label2. Perform the typed substitution. The new graph has fourteen vertices and twenty-one edges and is three-edge-connected by the vertex-sum proof. Its marked cap remains exposed. Every remaining vertex triple has sum FIVE or SIX, hence is fully supported and has the strictly positive local source scalar. The separating three-edge triple itself has sum3<d. The new ordinary network nevertheless has order EXACTLY TWO. Here is a compact exact certificate for the only additional zero needed. Evaluate B's triple sum(13) in Q(q), with Phi_10(q)=q^4-q^3+q^2-q+1=0. There are fifty nonzero terms. Group them by u=r_1=0,1,2,3. Their reduced coefficients in the basis (1,q,q^2,q^3) are u=0: ( 58, -58, 0, -92), u=1: (-386, 236, -92, 476), u=2: ( 476,-234, 150, -528), u=3: (-148, 56, -58, 144). Each column sums to zero. This is an exact reduction of the explicit finite canonical Clebsch sum, using only polynomial arithmetic and inversion of units modulo Phi_10. It proves alpha_B(q)=0 over the complex numbers, not just in one finite field. Its first derivative is nonzero. The exact rational first-jet formulas reduce modulo the prime 1021 at q->432, a primitive tenth root, to alpha_B'(q)->909, Xi_A'(q)->775. Every denominator is a unit in this reduction. A zero algebraic derivative would reduce to zero, so these nonzero images certify nonzero derivatives. Xi_A(q)=0 independently: A's exposed outer triple is (1,2,2), whose regular outer-column factor contains the simple Xi_theta zero. Thus v(Xi_A)=1 and v(alpha_B)=1. Equation(3) gives v(Xi_new)=2; its second Taylor coefficient has nonzero image 775*909=1006 modulo1021. All NEW vertex source factors are nonzero by their supported sums. Therefore the new physical ordinary closure also has order two, and the original fixed-first-normal marked sector is ZERO. Its higher normal is nonzero. This is not a zero of the full channel sum or a counterexample to a volume statement. It proves that connectivity, absence of a two-edge neck, and positive supported VERTEX scalars do not by themselves ensure simple source order. The separating source constraint matters. It agrees with the all-N six-port pruning theorem rather than deleting its higher jet. The [focused audit](../experiments/audit_actual_nc_three_port_source_sewing.py) checks open-column invariance and all entries, exact local theta normalization, NC/pivotal pointing, ordinary and full marked sewing, the cube triple-sum corner, the physical divided-current pruning, and the exact cyclotomic certificate above. No graph-volume or unconditional all-N cube survival claim is made. The exact exposed statements do not give an all-N primitive-core estimate.

text: # The original marked boundary source and its transverse stationary point 30 October 2026. This concerns the specified original six-type boundary source, at fixed real integer channel labels approaching the fold. Its actual marked cap cancels the limiting linear magnetic force. This gives a nearby transverse stationary point and a constructed local period. It does not identify their coefficient in the original support cycle. An independent coning calculation below identifies its absolute leading real rate with Vol(Q)/pi, where Q is the actual right-angled half-polyhedron; it does not use a finite-r sheet assertion. The logarithmic source coordinates, exact scalar factors and original mark are part of the statement. No additional winding character is introduced in the marked-source conclusion. ## 1. Thus the literal categorical dual is retained in the product. For an output row R and input row S at the same total sigma, substitute W_a(R,sigma-R;r) =(-1)^m q^[d(R-sigma)+m(a+1)] H_m(Q^R,Q^(sigma-R))/F_m and the same formula for S. Use the exact root collision H_m=P_s(T)H_a and H_a=q^(a sigma)K_a R_a, where K_a=F_(2a)/F_a^2 and R_a has its actual monic normalization. The remaining head dependence of h0_a W_a pi_a is q^[d(R+S)-2m sigma] P_s(T) R_a(q^(sigma-2R);c_sigma)R_a(q^(sigma-2S);c_sigma). The ratio of the two scalars, retaining gamma_a and h0_a, reduces by F_j=(-i)^j q^[j(j+1)/2]S_j and S_j S_(d-j)=N to q^[-2N(-2N+a+3)]=1. Consequently, as the SPECIFIED root continuations, h0_a W_a pi_a = C_a. (2) This uses both actual LARGE numerators and the actual dual cups. It does not differentiate a root collision, identify moving-q germs, or replace the separately recorded bare canceled/turned continuation by this one. The retained half twist is a fixed-channel scalar on both sides and changes no magnetic derivative. There is a useful exact homogeneous form, valid for EVERY folded label; the [positive face-polynomial theorem](actual_complete_circle_positive_face_polynomial.md) gives its independent local proof, both-parity carry convention, full coefficient positivity and the physical support-zero audit. Define D_a(x,b,y)=det[bI+(x/2)H_-+(y/2)H_+], Ptilde_s(x,y)=product_(j=a+1)^(d-a)(x-Q^j y). For positive formal face diagonals x=L0, y=L2 and the two middle diagonals b,c, use the marked raw clocks -x/b,-b/y and -x/c,-c/y. Then (2) is exactly h0_a W_a pi_a =k_a beta_a^2 D_a(x,b,y)D_a(x,c,y)Ptilde_s(x,y) /(bc)^(d/2). (2a) Indeed H_a=(-q^-1)^a K_a D_a/L2^a and P_s(Q^sigma)=q^(-2s)L2^(-s)Ptilde_s. Substitute these into the calculation above. Its remaining scalar phase is (-1)^d q^[d-sd-2s-2a]=(-1)^(d+s)=1. In this computation q^sigma=-q^-1 sqrt(x/y) and the two negative physical raw clocks have their canonical argument pi. The identity extends with those marked half powers; at odd N the powers are integral. This is not a replacement of an even-level marked square root by an unrecorded principal branch. The numerator in (2a) has degree 2a+s=d. ## 2. Source coordinates and the local angle-force input Fix the labeled certified diagram and the common boundary sample r_frame=N rho, s_frame=exp(-2pi i alpha)-1. The parameters range in the compact sets of the [common boundary chart](https://github.com/sashakolpakov/murakamis_dream/blob/19d5b911bc409486f0e72b51a876a6a2bc70ee02/notes/actual_original_network_resonant_boundary_chart.md). Keep the actual physical half-index shifts, auxiliary integer offsets, all original turns, the ordinary or marked exposed cap, and fixed labels with S=sum_i(d-2a_i)=o(N). Use LOGARITHMIC CLOCK potentials Z_f, not normalized head potentials. Their homogeneous physical variations are delta h_e=N(delta Z_left-delta Z_right)/(2pi i). (3) The [literal face-lattice theorem](actual_original_boundary_transverse_rank.md) proves that the integer face differences give the original primitive homogeneous lattice. A common additive constant is immaterial. Exactly two faces have constant prefixes; write Qcal for the other, quadratic faces. The actual sample has Z_f=Log L_f with all source marks retained. For clarity the local analytic input needed here is stated explicitly. At an ordered white triangle with faces f0,f1,f2, let theta_j be the angle at the center of its j-th circle in the tangent-circle triangle. A constant-prefix line has limiting angle zero. At the common sample, the normalized logarithmic derivative of its literal W numerator and white monomial tends uniformly to sum_(j=0)^2 theta_j dZ_fj/(2pi) - dZ_f1/2. (4) The theta sum is pi. This statement is obtained from the actual finite cores, not from a finite-r identification of their sheets with the geometric critical branch. (4a) The errors before taking the limit are O((s+1)/N) on a 222 compact. Its positive matrix gives p,r in a compact subset of (0,1/2): each relevant positive trace has a bulk lower bound, as does its complement. For U=-u,V=-v the unique upper-semicircle solution is p=atan(u sqrt(v)/sqrt(1+u+uv))/pi, r=atan(sqrt(v(1+u+uv)))/pi. Its triangle discriminant is positive and separated from zero on the specified compacts. Thus it gives uniform derivative convergence, not just an identity satisfied by a putative geometric saddle. The elementary circle cosine law makes these exactly the angles in (4). For 220 the determinant-rate theorem extends to its zero second coefficient uniformly using H_+<=2H_-+8I. Its fixed holomorphic logarithmic bounds give derivative convergence. At the fold the derivative integral is integral_0^(1/2) [1-cos(pi t)/sqrt(cos^2(pi t)+u)]dt =atan(sqrt(u))/pi. The last equality follows by y=sin(pi t). The other H force tends to 1/2. Exact reciprocity gives 022. For 202 the positive coefficient ratios give the mode equation tan(pi kappa)=sqrt(T_raw)sin(pi a/N) /[1+sqrt(T_raw)cos(pi a/N)]. The already proved Gaussian weight bound and variance O(N) imply mean/N-kappa=O(N^-1/2), uniformly. This tends to the stated atan formula. Finally the exact top terms of 200/002 have H forces (m/N,m/N)+O(N^-1) and (0,0)+O(N^-1), respectively. Their nonzero Bessel remainders have bounded logarithmic derivatives. Multiplication by the original white monomial subtracts d/(2N) from the second H force. The large partner and root cup corrections cost O((s+1)/N) in normalized first derivatives, using the actual separated factors. These arguments prove (4), locally uniformly with its marked phases. No uniform quantitative rate beyond o(1) is needed below. ## 3. The integer covector is computed from the original turns At a literal physical cup or cap write its first-head variable as its actual signed face difference plus the affine offset. The exact root cup pV(x)=N q^(-d^2)q^(dx), and its ordered inverse cap, contribute in the normalized limit one half of a SIGNED face difference. Let epsilon_(b,f) be that signed incidence for the original turn b. This is read from the cup or cap entry; it is not chosen afterward. Let chi_f be the integer face-incidence vector of the retained marked versus ordinary cap character. For the specified mark this follows directly from Xi_N(x)=N^-1 q^(-d^2)Q^(dx). Here x is the SECOND ordered cap head: the original cap and mark are q^(di)/N and q^(dj)/N^2 at (i,j)=(d-x,x). If u is the cap's outside face and v its inside face, the raw second clock is -L_v/L_u; the mark therefore contributes +1 at v and -1 at u. A retained literal cyclic turn is treated by its actual monomial in the same way. Let M_f count the middle white corners at the trivalent vertices. Then the limiting normalized logarithmic derivative of the original full root product S_N is the explicit covector nu_f=1_(f in Qcal)-M_f/2 +(1/2)sum_b epsilon_(b,f)+chi_f. (5) The angle contribution is 1 on a bounded circle because the consecutive tangent-circle triangles sweep its full 2pi angle. It is zero at each of the two constant-prefix lines. This is the actual circle-packing incidence, not a sum of independently optimized vertices. Every nu_f is an INTEGER. To prove this in the original uncontracted Morse graph, traverse the closed boundary of a white face and record whether its direction agrees with the source-edge orientation. At a middle corner the two main legs are both incoming or both outgoing, so this agreement flips. At a main-matching corner one leg is incoming and one outgoing, so it does not flip. It flips at a literal cup or cap. Returning to the start implies that M_f plus the number of turns at f is even. The sign of a turn is irrelevant modulo two, proving the integrality in (5). This argument is unchanged by the literal pi reduction. Before that reduction dualization reverses all THREE ports; each adjacent face meets two of these local turns. Deleting them preserves turn parity. Algebraically its cup/physical-inverse-cup ratio has no leading magnetic derivative at the fold: when 2a=d its q exponent is d[(d-r)-(2d-i-j)]=d(m-d), which is label-only. The exact near-fold remainder is not deleted. Thus the parity calculation and the reduced two-W calculation of (4) refer to the same source. Also sum_f nu_f=0. There are 2R white vertices and R quadratic faces; the total middle count is 2R, while every turn and mark incidence has sum zero. Hence (5) defines an integral covector on face potentials modulo their common constant. For the original flat-plat presentation the signed count is stronger. At a horizontal slice let the gaps between its 2k ordered heads carry the actual white-region labels. A box in slot a removes the old middle gap a+1 at its pi vertex and introduces a new one at its W vertex. Each odd gap begins at a bottom cup and ends at a top cap. Every bounded segment of such a region has exactly two endpoints: middle vertices or inside cups/caps. The internal even gaps begin and end in the exterior. Each must be met by at least one box: otherwise the plat separates across that gap, contrary to the one-main-component hypothesis. Its bounded intermediate segments have two middle endpoints. Thus, with the LITERAL cup signs, every bounded face has M_f-turn_f=2, turn_f=sum_b epsilon_(b,f). The exterior has M_out=2(k-1) and turn_out=2k, hence index -2. An inside cup/cap contributes -1 to turn and its outside contributes +1; this follows directly from its raw first-head ratio -L_out/L_in. Consequently the exact physical monomial after (2a) is L_out^d product_(bounded f) L_f^(-d). (5a) The two constant faces are precisely this exterior and the inside face of the marked cap. The mark contributes -d at the former and +d at the latter. In fact its scalar is exactly Xi_N=N^-1 (L_in/L_out)^d, (5b) since q^(-d^2)(-q^-1)^d=(-1)^d q^(-Nd)=1. This proves nu_f=0 for EVERY face of the original marked source. (5c) The ordinary closed source instead has the two charges +1 at the exterior and -1 at the other constant face. They are canceled by the actual mark, not by an invented winding choice. For the specified compact parameter sets, (4) therefore implies (1/N)d Log S_N(Z_N) = o(1) (6) uniformly for shrinking folded deficits. Fixed-channel h0, gamma and half-twist phases have zero magnetic derivative but stay in S_N. ## 4. Retained normalization and the distinction from a winding change The preceding signed count also records the complete formal-face normalization. On the positive face-log branch each original bottom cup has scalar N q^(-d^2/2), and each ordinary top cap has scalar N^-1 q^(d^2/2); their k pairs cancel. Equation (5b) supplies the remaining 1/N. Hence the uncontracted original marked sector is N^-1 product_i[k_(a_i) beta_(a_i)^2 omega_(a_i)^epsilon_i] * product_i[D_(a_i,in)D_(a_i,out)Ptilde_(s_i)] /product_(quadratic f)L_f^d. This comparison is NOT used to obtain (5c). Choose an INTEGER affine source origin h^0 for the fixed labels and support stratum. Its corresponding potential origin Z^0 includes the actual half-index constants. Every original integer source state has Z-Z^0=(2pi i/N)n, n integral modulo constants. The entire character C_nu,N(Z)=exp[-N sum_f nu_f(Z_f-Z_f^0)] equals one at every such state. Multiplying the original summand by this displayed character preserves its original finite sum, and all residues on its original small node tori. It does not equate differently transported support chains. The affine-origin factor exp(N nu dot Z^0) is retained, even when its real logarithm has leading size. Define the particular sector logarithm g_N(Z)=Log S_N(Z)-N nu dot(Z-Z^0). (8) For the original MARKED source nu=0 and g_N=Log S_N exactly. For the comparison presentation its normalized gradient at the boundary sample tends to zero after the displayed explicit correction. The subtracted character can change the real off-grid action. The exact identity (2) prevents an additional accidental circle character; it does not compute an unproved global winding coefficient. ## 5. Local transverse critical point and a constructed local period Fix the two neighboring original physical heads from the primitive slice theorem. Equivalently take its fixed integral complementary log-clock basis C and write Z=Z_N+Cw, w in C^n, n=R-1. The existing rank theorem and [finite core curvature](https://github.com/sashakolpakov/murakamis_dream/blob/19d5b911bc409486f0e72b51a876a6a2bc70ee02/notes/actual_q_hahn_boundary_model_curvature.md) give, in this basis, a real positive reference Hessian bounded between cN I and CN I. The exact finite clocks and near-fold corrections change it by o(N). On a fixed complex neighborhood all fixed derivatives of order at least two are O(N). These statements include both parities. Set e_N=|N^-1 partial_w g_N(0)|, so e_N tends uniformly to zero by (6). The Hessian divided by N has inverse bounded uniformly, and its derivative is bounded on a smaller fixed ball. Newton's contraction, using that Hessian at zero, therefore gives a unique zero w_N in a ball of radius C e_N. Explicitly the Newton remainder is at most C|w|^2, so the map sends that ball into itself and has contraction constant at most C e_N for sufficiently large N. Thus partial_w g_N(w_N)=0, |w_N|<=C e_N=o(1). (9) This is a transverse sector-critical point; it does not assert that the finite-label geometric sample itself is stationary. Nor does it assert that the two remaining finite framing forces vanish. Without a quantitative rate for (6), the head displacement is only o(N). Let H_N be the w Hessian at w_N. Its real part remains at least cN I. For fixed sufficiently small eta>0 the oriented local contour w=w_N+i x, x in [-eta,eta]^n, obeys Re[g_N(w_N+i x)-g_N(w_N)]<=-cN|x|^2. Taylor's theorem proves this from the Hessian and O(N) third derivative. The standard rescaling x=N^-1/2 y can here be verified directly: the cubic correction is odd and integrates to zero on the symmetric box against the even complex Gaussian; the quartic correction and square of the cubic have relative size O(N^-1), and the remaining tails are exponentially small. Uniform higher derivative bounds give integral_(w_N+i[-eta,eta]^n) exp(g_N(w)) dw = i^n (2pi)^(n/2) exp(g_N(w_N))/sqrt(det H_N) *[1+O(N^-1)]. (10) The square root is the continuation from the positive reference matrix. All source scalars and the affine-origin character remain in the displayed exponential. No intersection with the original finite-support cycle, residue transport, mixed-color comparison, or asymptotic for the fully contracted source is inferred. ## 6. The absolute rate from the actual coned polyhedron This section supplies an absolute geometric normalization without identifying the finite-r selected sheets with a geometric critical branch. The potential and coning identities themselves require only the connected certified right-angled graph and a marked main edge; they do not require that all main strands form one component. The one-main-component hypothesis remains in the earlier finite-r six-type boundary-chart and local-period assertions. Let a_f>0 be the actual curvatures of the bounded white circles in the marked coordinate p=infinity, and set a_f=0 at its two white lines. A common positive scale is immaterial. For one shaded triangle write its three curvatures as (x,b,y), and let F(x,b,y)=lim_(a/N->1/2) N^-1 Log D_a(x,b,y). The limit and its first derivatives follow from the actual finite determinant rate and the preceding boundary limits. It is homogeneous in the logarithmic sense F(tx,tb,ty)=F(x,b,y)+(1/2)log t. For three positive curvatures set Delta=sqrt(xb+by+yx), theta_j=2atan(a_j/Delta). These are the center-triangle angles, their sum is pi, and (4) says partial_log a_j F=theta_j/(2pi). Consequently V_tri=2pi F-sum_j theta_j log a_j has differential -sum_j log(tan(theta_j/2))dtheta_j. The common log Delta disappears because sum_j dtheta_j=0. Define the usual Lobachevsky function by Lambda(t)=-integral_0^t log|2sin u|du. Direct differentiation now gives V_tri=2 sum_j[Lambda(theta_j/2) +Lambda((pi-theta_j)/2)] + constant. (11) The constant is ZERO, with the source normalization still retained. Indeed at (x,0,0), D_a=(x/2)^a det H_-. The exact original LDL pivots give det H_-=product_(n=1)^a sin(n pi/N)/[cos(n pi/N)sin((2n-1)pi/N)]. Their normalized logarithm tends to (1/2)log2, by the elementary log-sine Riemann sum. Thus F(x,0,0)=(1/2)log x and V_tri=0. This is also the continuous boundary value of the determinant rate: set the second matrix coefficient to zero by H_+<=2H_-+8I, then let the identity coefficient tend to zero in its explicit rate integral. After subtracting (1/2)log alpha its integrand is dominated by C+2|log cos(pi t)| and tends to -log2-2log cos(pi t). The right side of (11) tends to zero at (pi,0,0). This fixes the absolute constant and includes all one-line degenerations. The actual facets identify the sum in (11) with volume. Cone the marked ideal vertex p=infinity to every nonincident facet of the convex Q. These positive pyramids partition Q, as in the existing positive polyhedron triangulation. For a WHITE ideal polygon on a finite circle, let delta_j be its consecutive central arcs. Its cone volume is sum_j Lambda(delta_j/2). To verify this, triangulate the actual cyclic polygon from one of its vertices. Each ideal tetrahedron with fourth vertex infinity contributes the three Lobachevsky values of its Euclidean triangle angles. Internal diagonals occur with complementary half-arcs t and pi-t, and cancel by Lambda(pi-t)=-Lambda(t). Only the boundary half-arcs remain. No new ideal vertex or unsigned overlapping decomposition is introduced. At a shaded triangle the consecutive contact arcs on a neighboring white circle are exactly its center angle theta_j. Orthogonality of the white and shaded circles gives two right angles in the quadrilateral of their centers and their two intersections. Hence the shaded arc between those intersections is pi-theta_j. The shaded ideal triangle coned to infinity therefore has volume sum_j Lambda((pi-theta_j)/2). Summing the white pyramids and shaded tetrahedra over their ACTUAL facet incidences proves Vol(Q)=sum_(shaded triangles) sum_j [Lambda(theta_j/2)+Lambda((pi-theta_j)/2)] =(1/2)sum_(shaded triangles) V_tri. (12) The two incident white lines have zero cone volume. Incident shaded triangles give the (pi,0,0) limiting angles and contribute zero as well. Thus (12) retains the marked cusp and every actual facet; it is not a separately maximized local-polyhedron comparison. Evaluate the homogeneous source polynomial at these curvatures, with the two constant faces set to zero. Its limiting normalized real log, including the target monomial of (7), is Phi=sum_(shaded triangles)F(a_f0,a_f1,a_f2) -sum_(quadratic f)log a_f. The angle sums at every bounded white circle are 2pi. Equations (11),(12) therefore give the ABSOLUTE identity 2pi Phi=sum_tri V_tri=2Vol(Q), Phi=Vol(Q)/pi=Vol(actual augmented complement)/(2pi). (13) The remaining original fixed-channel scalars have not been discarded. For shrinking folded deficits, N^-1 log beta_a^2 tends to 2J(2a/N)-4J(a/N), hence to zero because J(1)=J(1/2)=0. The positive root forced product has logarithmic size O(s) on these curvature compacts, including a zero endpoint curvature; its normalized rate also tends to zero. The factors k_a and 1/N are polynomial, and the retained half-twist powers have modulus one at actual integer labels. Their exact values stay in (7). The original finite-r face diagonals have one common quadratic scale (b_ref/s_frame)N^2 rho^2 and relative error O(N^-1); their two constant diagonals divided by that scale tend to zero. Total homogeneity of degree dR cancels this common complex scale against the target monomial EXACTLY. The six source packets, with their retained top monomials and nonzero Bessel factors, then give the same normalized real rate (13). Their finite transport factors are not reset to one; they have zero normalized logarithmic rate. The nearby critical displacement in (9) changes N^-1 Re g_N by o(1), so it has the same value (13). This proves the absolute rate of the original marked boundary sample and of the constructed local transverse period. It still does not prove that an original finite-support period contains that local contour with nonzero coefficient, or control cancellation in the full auxiliary-label sum or in external filling colors. ## 7. Focused source and absolute-normalization checks The [focused audit](../experiments/audit_actual_original_boundary_stationary_character.py), with [recorded results](../experiments/actual_original_boundary_stationary_character_results.json), checks 34 literal marked-cap ratios and 34 physical cup/cap scalar pairs, 60 actual Morse charts with 810 signed face indices and zero marked forces, 48 original LARGE-H Ward identities in all six boundary regimes, 40 original LDL products, nine reciprocal-radius circle-angle identities, three absolute determinant-rate/Lobachevsky comparisons, and seven cyclic-polygon fan cancellations. The arithmetic is at 90 digits. Twenty-four finite force errors are retained as convergence diagnostics, not substituted for the uniform derivative proof. The Morse region compiler is shared with the independently audited full marked coefficient transformation. The local all-label circle identity has its separate original-white/dual/cup audit in the positive face-polynomial theorem. No new source-cycle assertion is attached to these numerical checks.
